Amethyst Crown.basicInfo: Southeastern pale-rock islands support violet flowering heath, angular ridges, mineral pools and narrow grassy shelves. Singing stone formations carry wind across the open plateaus. There is no city: a weather shelter marks the practical approach to the frontier. Wildlife here uses sound, concealment and broken sightlines; the innermost crown is an exceptional level-48–55 expedition site, still within the midgame range.

Sepulchral Gardens.name: Sepulchral Gardens
Sepulchral Gardens.basicInfo: A compact abandoned sanctuary of glasshouses, memorial trees and irrigation walks. The portal house is a staging refuge; inner gardens hold plant-bodied undead guardians and an intelligent caretaker. This is a midgame expedition with real retreat routes.

Blackpine March.name: Blackpine March
Blackpine March.basicInfo: Western cedar ridges, hamlets, waterfalls and old roadside shrines. The maintained post road serves everyday journeys; deeper forest hollows have their own occupants.

Thundercrag Highlands.name: Thundercrag Highlands
Thundercrag Highlands.basicInfo: A great terraced quarry and working mine basin below jagged ridges. Stone roads serve inhabited works, while abandoned cuts and high scree are dangerous.

Mount Shiun.name: Mount Shiun
Mount Shiun.basicInfo: The sacred mountain rises behind the capital. Pilgrim lodgings, cedar stairs, pagodas and waterfalls occupy its lower approaches; snow and exposed ridges lie above.

Snowcedar Heights.name: Snowcedar Heights
Snowcedar Heights.basicInfo: Snowbound mountains, blue tarns and isolated conifer valleys. A sheltered pass links the few attended refuges. Glacial basins and ruined watchposts demand preparation.

Mizuhara Lake Country.name: Mizuhara Lake Country
Mizuhara Lake Country.basicInfo: The western castle town and its lakeshore villages share ferries, fish markets and irrigated terraces. The castle is a working seat above a broad landing, not a second national capital.

Bamboo Veil Valleys.name: Bamboo Veil Valleys
Bamboo Veil Valleys.basicInfo: Green bamboo valleys connect the western country with Benitsuru. Mills, bridges, paper workshops and small farms stand along bright tributaries; abandoned groves have less welcoming inhabitants.

Benitsuru Basin.name: Benitsuru Basin
Benitsuru Basin.basicInfo: The capital beneath the sacred mountain: Shogunal castle, canal wards, shrines, guildhall and dense neighborhoods. Its streets are inhabited civic space, with roads radiating toward both castle towns.

Koganedai Terraces.name: Koganedai Terraces
Koganedai Terraces.basicInfo: The eastern castle town stands above gold-leaved terraces, artisan streets, training grounds and timber approaches. House Tsubakiri guards a small imported-device workshop.

Golden Grain Plain.name: Golden Grain Plain
Golden Grain Plain.basicInfo: Working grain fields, paddies, orchards and riverside villages feed the towns. Travelers encounter ordinary farm business as often as trouble; the principal road is maintained.

Mirror-Reed Lowlands.name: Mirror-Reed Lowlands
Mirror-Reed Lowlands.basicInfo: Wooded low ridges, cedar paths and a narrow river descending beneath an arched bridge. Reeds gather along the northern water margin, but most of this province is forest, rocky slopes and clearings. Small hamlets, dye gardens and roadside shrines serve walkers and pack traffic; the principal crossing is a bridge.

Redleaf River Country.name: Redleaf River Country
Redleaf River Country.basicInfo: Maple-red valleys, riverside shrines, guesthouses and broad old bridges. Locals use the main road; wooded side trails and abandoned festival grounds have stranger traffic.

Lanternwood Border.name: Lanternwood Border
Lanternwood Border.basicInfo: Ancient wooded escarpments, waterfalls and shrines among enormous roots. The Soul Torii occupies a reachable lower approach, while the far cedar hollows shelter dangerous beings.

Veiled Cedar Reach.name: Veiled Cedar Reach
Veiled Cedar Reach.basicInfo: Dense fog layers a compact wilderness of cedar roots, wet low ground and an old festival road. The western threshold and Bellroot Refuge are usable staging places. Lantern Marsh and the listening woods lead toward a crane crossing and a more dangerous pale grove. These sites share physical paths; voices and fog do not transport someone without actual movement.

Evertree District.name: Evertree District
Evertree District.basicInfo: The Evertree rises above pale civic buildings, gardens and the northern residential quarter. Broad approaches connect the court, the Cloud District and the great avenue below. Public streets and controlled palace rooms have different access.

Northwest District.name: Northwest District
Northwest District.basicInfo: Green western ridges descend toward the northwestern city wall. Greywatch Keep and the Emberfox pools overlook roads leading to Phoenix Wing and the upper residential streets. The maintained approaches are busy; wooded slopes beyond them grow quieter.

Harbor District.name: Harbor District
Harbor District.basicInfo: Northern shore roads meet the working waterfront and Hydra Head Academy. Cargo sheds, homes, gardens and coastal farms share the approaches to Whitecrest Harbor. Beaconrest Lighthouse marks the offshore channel.

Whitecrest Isles.name: Whitecrest Isles
Whitecrest Isles.basicInfo: Rocky islands and sheltered channels lie beyond the harbor. Saltmere and Driftstone support ordinary island households, while the isolated skull-shaped Wraith Island receives controlled prison traffic. Weather and working boats shape everyday journeys.

Southwest District.name: Southwest District
Southwest District.basicInfo: Western gates, Gryffin Tail and closely fitted residential streets occupy the southwestern city. Rougher Greyfield housing gathers outside the southern walls, beyond which the land rises into pines. Maintained streets remain ordinary civic ground.

Artisan Quarter.name: Artisan Quarter
Artisan Quarter.basicInfo: Founders’ arcades, workshops, inns and the Crucible fill the central southern wards. Timber carts and students share the streets with shoppers and craftspeople. The lower wall separates working neighborhoods from the patched roofs of Greyfield.

Southeast District.name: Southeast District
Southeast District.basicInfo: Dragon Hoard, the eastern residential wards and the south gate overlook shore roads and neighboring farms. Commercial lanes connect the central city with Pebblewick and the coast. Workshops and quiet homes continue between the larger landmarks.

Crescent Coast.name: Crescent Coast
Crescent Coast.basicInfo: Curved beaches and small rocky islands follow the coast south of Whitecrest. Inns, fishers and visiting boats use the sheltered inshore water. Exposed reefs require care even when the nearby beaches are peaceful.

Pinewater Vale.name: Pinewater Vale
Pinewater Vale.basicInfo: Pinewater winds between wooded banks, farm tracks and the lanes around Pebbletown. Caravan staging and a remote alchemical cottage stand near the crossings. Water level, loose banks and ordinary animal activity give practical work to people who know the valley.

Seaward Bluffs.name: Seaward Bluffs
Seaward Bluffs.basicInfo: Forested coastal bluffs give way to open meadows above a winding river. Starlark Abbey offers a settled presence inland, while the Seaward Overlook remains a quiet place to watch the sea. Exposed edges and weather demand sensible footing.

Bluecoil Reach.name: Bluecoil Reach
Bluecoil Reach.basicInfo: Open blue water surrounds distant reefs, the Gilded Albatross anchorage and an isolated serpent resting place. Sailors distinguish ordinary coastal passages from the waters around a sleeping great beast. Sudden swells and scarce landing places reward preparation.

Moonarch Shoals.name: Moonarch Shoals
Moonarch Shoals.basicInfo: Broken island stonework, a stranded wreck and broad shell-shaped rocks interrupt the eastern sea. Fishers know usable approaches and signs of larger creatures passing beneath them. The wreck waters are considerably less forgiving than the sheltered island coves.

Greenrush Marshes.name: Greenrush Marshes
Greenrush Marshes.basicInfo: The river breaks into shallow tidal channels, reed beds and sandbars before meeting the eastern sea. Boatwrights, fishers and field workers use its changing margins. Dry-looking ground can flood quickly with an incoming tide.

Longgrass Meadows.name: Longgrass Meadows
Longgrass Meadows.basicInfo: Wide grasslands stretch between the western forest and the lower river. A few farmsteads and cart tracks leave large areas of open ground. Herding, gathering and ordinary rural travel occupy more of the landscape than ruins or fortifications.

Sunmead Plain.name: Sunmead Plain
Sunmead Plain.basicInfo: Low hills, open pasture and scattered copses fill the southern plain. Thin dirt lanes link homesteads with the river crossings and neighboring meadows. Long sightlines let travelers notice weather, livestock and distant trouble before approaching.

Greenfield Farmlands.name: Greenfield Farmlands
Greenfield Farmlands.basicInfo: Cultivated strips and scattered homesteads spread beyond Greyfield and the city’s southern approaches. Irrigation branches lead toward the wider river country, while wooded margins conceal quieter ground. Farm roads carry produce, laborers and travelers.

Westpine Forest.name: Westpine Forest
Westpine Forest.basicInfo: Pines cover western ridges beside the lower river country. Clear working paths and old crossings skirt denser wildlife habitat. Woodcutters and walkers use the forest without treating every quiet clearing as a monster lair.

Southglade Woods.name: Southglade Woods
Southglade Woods.basicInfo: Southern woodland rises around an old stone lookout and scattered clearings. The outer tracks meet open grazing country; deeper folds of forest shelter wary animals. Old Southwatch can be reached without searching for a secret road.

Brookmeadow Downs.name: Brookmeadow Downs
Brookmeadow Downs.basicInfo: Open downs and the westward village approaches surround a working windmill. A crossroads links the northern road, river bridge and farm lanes. It is settled countryside with room for travelers to pass without becoming part of every local dispute.

Brookmeadow Vale.name: Brookmeadow Vale
Brookmeadow Vale.basicInfo: Brookmeadow’s houses, green and crop plots stand beside a river approach in the southeastern countryside. Farmers, mill customers and visiting workers share the lanes. The village remains a familiar local beginning within Glowhaven’s wider territory.

Phoenix Wing Academy.name: Phoenix Wing Academy
Phoenix Wing Academy.basicInfo:
Red pennants snap above dueling rings and noticeboards crowded with cooking contests and field-partner requests. Visitors can ask about lessons, book supervised practice, consult instructors, or watch a legal bout. Kōhei Sanada handles academic permissions; Ritsu Kurogane teaches Magical Combat, Haruki Saitō teaches Magic Theory, and Ranka Kagari teaches Potions & Alchemy. Akane Todo is the academy's Archon, with duties beyond its reception desk.

Its public-service training emphasizes defense, readiness, threat assessment, and supervised protective fieldwork. Posted expedition opportunities require actual court authorization and do not deputize students. Every student must complete expedition beyond the Glowhaven region training; the academy can explain requirements without forcing an assignment on a visitor.

Core subjects: Magic Theory — Haruki Saitō; Magical Combat — Ritsu Kurogane; Potions & Alchemy — Ranka Kagari. Common principles feed into supervised duels and laboratory practice. Students can connect an explanation to a controlled fight or test a formula with actual ingredients. New first-years are already admitted when the year opens: they collect a timetable, attend the headmaster’s welcome, and begin required morning lessons. Afternoons include preparation, partner work and scheduled practicals, with breaks and optional activities around those responsibilities.

Phoenix Wing Academy - Arrival Court.description: A broad stone forecourt beneath the academy crest. Students and visitors gather here between buildings.

Phoenix Wing Academy - Main Hall.description: The central corridor joins classrooms, dining space, and administrative offices; class notices cover the walls. On the academic year's opening morning, this room hosts Kōhei Sanada's first-year welcome; afterward the headmaster returns to Faculty Offices and ordinary scheduled use resumes. A noticeboard points students toward paid afternoon kitchen, inn and library shifts around morning classes, beside an invitation to visit the public guild hall without registering.

Phoenix Wing Academy - Lecture Hall.description: Haruki Saitō's chalk diagrams stop at the step students commonly misunderstand. Tiered benches face a broad slate board. Students attend lessons, and visitors can ask a focused question when the class allows. The posted teaching plan lists Magic Theory, Magical Combat, Potions & Alchemy. Use the actual assigned professor for a lesson; a generic classroom does not force their presence outside a real class or arrangement.

Phoenix Wing Academy - Training Yard.description: An open practice ground with marked lanes, padded posts, and space for supervised drills.

Phoenix Wing Academy - Practice Arena.description: Posted terms identify permitted spells, stopping signals, and supervision before a match. Kōta Arakawa and Sōma Kisaragi can seek practice partners independently; agreeing to a duel does not recruit either student.

Phoenix Wing Academy - Student Commons.description: A comfortable student lounge for conversation, casual study, and breaks between classes. Club notices and student announcements cover the nearby boards.

Phoenix Wing Academy - Dining Hall.description: A bright dining hall with long tables and a serving counter provides regular meals for students and staff. Its doors open toward the central campus route, making it a natural meeting place before and after lessons.

Phoenix Wing Academy - Faculty Offices.description: Kōhei Sanada handles appointments, complaints, and assessment queries. Ranka Kagari's trial sheets are private documents, obtained through permission or an actual investigation rather than narrated to every visitor. Kōhei Sanada normally works here, including receiving new instructors. A teaching appointment specifies its subject, classroom and first lesson at the next morning's first bell.

Phoenix Wing Academy - Dormitory Wing.description: Residential rooms line a quiet corridor around a shared lounge and noticeboard. The wing houses students who live on campus and gives them a place to rest between the academy's busy days.

Phoenix Wing Academy - Sun Terrace.description: A sheltered upper terrace has stone benches, planters, and a view across the campus. Students come here to cool down after practice, talk, or enjoy a little quiet outdoors.

Phoenix Wing Academy - Music Room.description: A comfortable room with a few instruments and space to gather supports informal practice, student-led music, and relaxed breaks away from lessons.

Phoenix Wing Academy.hiddenInfo:
Ranka Kagari has a promising recovery formula and inconsistent dosage sheets. She wants profits without inconvenient oversight; a serious adverse reaction could cost her teaching post. Haruki Saitō noticed the incompatible sheets but has not established the cause. Evidence could support corrected trials, a delayed sale, a private bargain, or a complaint to Kōhei Sanada. Preserve Ranka Kagari's selfishness and irritation. The dueling club independently needs partners, scorekeepers, and controlled drills. Surface one relevant opportunity when approached; resolved incidents stay resolved.

Use only relevant unresolved situations. Introduce evidence through observation or people who know it. Preserve actual resolutions and player choices; these possibilities are not events that automatically occur on every visit. Ritsu Kurogane can also offer a voluntary stopping-control drill with Takeru Akabane and Yūma Kurobane. Treat Yūma Kurobane's grand claims as role-play, never secret power.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: Phoenix Wing: A Spell of Your Own; Phoenix Wing: One Question Worth Answering; The Line Behind You; The Prize in the Flask; A Demonstration of Terrible Importance. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.
If the player actually seeks a small personal spell experiment, Your First Spell is an optional existing goal. Use real available teaching/help and actual learned disciplines; do not force this on ordinary visitors or interrupt the selected opening lesson.

Hydra Head Academy.name: Hydra Head Academy
Hydra Head Academy.basicInfo:
Violet awnings shade garden paths and broad tables where apparently incompatible people keep working together. Visitors can arrange consultations, observe demonstrations, discuss commissions, or join invited practice. Kiyoko Fujinami manages the school day with Reika Saionji. Kaoruko Hanazono teaches Herbology, Reon Fujisaki Enchantment, and Kana Fujimoto Magic Theory.

Public projects connect diplomacy, trade, logistics, mediation, and community assistance with broad magical and combat education. An approved expedition can need negotiation or provisioning as much as a fight. Court authorization and actual supervision are required; helpful mediation is not a judicial ruling.

Core subjects: Magic Theory — Kana Fujimoto; Enchantment — Reon Fujisaki; Herbology — Kaoruko Hanazono. General theory supports material enchantments and plant work with useful applications in care, craft, trade and public projects. Instructors retain their own methods and flaws. New first-years are already admitted when the year opens: they collect a timetable, attend the headmaster’s welcome, and begin required morning lessons. Afternoons include preparation, partner work and scheduled practicals, with breaks and optional activities around those responsibilities.

Hydra Head Academy - Arrival Court.description: A welcoming courtyard has several paths into campus and room for students to gather.

Hydra Head Academy - Confluence Hall.description:
The central hall opens toward seminar rooms and shared study spaces with broad group-work tables.

Civic coordination and proposed field assignments can be discussed here. The actual people, requirements, supplies, and permissions make a workable plan; no court authorization or personal agreement is supplied merely by entering the hall. On the academic year's opening morning, this room hosts Kiyoko Fujinami's first-year welcome; afterward the headmaster returns to Faculty Offices and ordinary scheduled use resumes. A noticeboard points students toward paid afternoon kitchen, inn and library shifts around morning classes, beside an invitation to visit the public guild hall without registering.

Hydra Head Academy - Seminar Room.description: Reon Fujisaki reviews designs and demonstrates practical enchantments. His affectionate address is professional warmth and does not establish attraction, consent, or recruitment. The posted teaching plan lists Magic Theory, Enchantment, Herbology. Use the actual assigned professor for a lesson; a generic classroom does not force their presence outside a real class or arrangement.

Hydra Head Academy - Practice Hall.description: The academy's main indoor training and dueling ground has movable partitions, padded boundaries, and a marked sparring floor. Instructors use it for supervised magical duels, paired drills, and coordinated team exercises.

Hydra Head Academy - Garden Walk.description: A quiet landscaped path beside the main buildings, with benches for time between lessons.

Hydra Head Academy - Student Commons.description: A shared lounge where clubs and student groups meet between lessons. Broad tables make it easy to gather and talk in small groups.

Hydra Head Academy - Dining Hall.description: A spacious dining hall uses joined tables and smaller seating groups around its serving counter. Students and staff share meals here, with room for both lively clubs and quieter conversations.

Hydra Head Academy - Faculty Offices.description: Private faculty offices open from a calm corridor with a small reception desk. Students can arrange consultations or find instructors between classes. Kiyoko Fujinami normally works here, including receiving new instructors. A teaching appointment specifies its subject, classroom and first lesson at the next morning's first bell.

Hydra Head Academy - Dormitory Wing.description: Residential rooms are arranged around shared lounges and a common noticeboard. The wing gives on-campus students places to rest, study together, or spend time with their roommates.

Hydra Head Academy - Lecture Hall.description: Kana Fujimoto's prepared examples have clear handling instructions. Homura Hibino finds restrained demonstrations disappointing, giving the instructor an ordinary recurring teaching problem rather than an explosion every lesson. The posted teaching plan lists Magic Theory, Enchantment, Herbology. Use the actual assigned professor for a lesson; a generic classroom does not force their presence outside a real class or arrangement.

Hydra Head Academy - Confluence Pavilion.description: Reika Saionji and Kiyoko Fujinami sometimes share an ordinary tea break here. Conversation does not grant research access or reveal their private accounts.

Hydra Head Academy.hiddenInfo:
A fragrance batch prepared with Kaoruko Hanazono changes on warm cloth after its carrier separates. Reika Saionji wants a viable collaboration without inconsistent goods. Céline Desrosiers at The Perfumed Rose can compare samples if consulted. A player can reblend, propose a smaller honest release, or delay the sale while protecting the buyer's private brief. No scent reads minds or compels attraction. Kana Fujimoto separately suspects an attentive classmate was an illusion left by Tōma Utsugi; these incidents need not happen together.

Use only relevant unresolved situations. Introduce evidence through observation or people who know it. Preserve actual resolutions and player choices; these possibilities are not events that automatically occur on every visit. Homura Hibino may seek a more spectacular demonstration than Kana Fujimoto permits. A clever low-yield design, approved practice time, or an honest refusal can resolve it; actual broken limits have consequences.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: Hydra Head: A Spell of Your Own; Hydra Head: One Question Worth Answering; A Costume with Opinions; A Very Dignified Relay; The Last Sweet on the Table. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.
If the player actually seeks a small personal spell experiment, Your First Spell is an optional existing goal. Use real available teaching/help and actual learned disciplines; do not force this on ordinary visitors or interrupt the selected opening lesson.

Gryffin Tail Academy.name: Gryffin Tail Academy
Gryffin Tail Academy.basicInfo:
Cyan banners hang above orderly lecture corridors, a sheltered reading garden, and a much less quiet training court. Visitors can attend announced lectures, request research access, arrange consultations, or find a study partner. Norio Shibata handles records and appointments. Gen'ichirō Mizuhara controls senior academic policy; professors retain individual priorities and methods.

Its research infrastructure is the most advanced of the four academies, with their sole formal magitech research specialization. Integrated engineering differs from an ordinary enchanted item. Supervised field investigations and court-authorized expeditions connect measurements to study; weak mana-transfer prototypes are research, not reliable medical equipment.

Core subjects: Magic Theory — Kei Aoki; Magical Engineering — Sōichirō Takamine; Magical Arts — Ririka Kujō. The theoretical course supports measured device work and expressive application. Engineering treats integrated magical/mechanical systems; arts gives the research-heavy campus a visibly different kind of classroom. New first-years are already admitted when the year opens: they collect a timetable, attend the headmaster’s welcome, and begin required morning lessons. Afternoons include preparation, partner work and scheduled practicals, with breaks and optional activities around those responsibilities.

Gryffin Tail Academy - Arrival Steps.description: The academy entrance opens onto a paved square with direction boards for classrooms and events.

Gryffin Tail Academy - Lecture Wing.description: A quiet corridor links lecture rooms, faculty offices, and student noticeboards. The posted teaching plan lists Magic Theory, Magical Engineering, Magical Arts. Use the actual assigned professor for a lesson; a generic classroom does not force their presence outside a real class or arrangement. A noticeboard points students toward paid afternoon kitchen, inn and library shifts around morning classes, beside an invitation to visit the public guild hall without registering.

Gryffin Tail Academy - Lecture Hall.description: A large tiered hall holds full-course lectures, public demonstrations, and cohort briefings. A raised teaching floor keeps the lesson visible from every row. The posted teaching plan lists Magic Theory, Magical Engineering, Magical Arts. Use the actual assigned professor for a lesson; a generic classroom does not force their presence outside a real class or arrangement. On the academic year's opening morning, this room hosts Norio Shibata's first-year welcome; afterward the headmaster returns to Faculty Offices and ordinary scheduled use resumes.

Gryffin Tail Academy - Seminar Room.description: A compact room with a central table for discussion, peer review, and small presentations. The posted teaching plan lists Magic Theory, Magical Engineering, Magical Arts. Use the actual assigned professor for a lesson; a generic classroom does not force their presence outside a real class or arrangement.

Gryffin Tail Academy - Research Rooms.description:
Bookable tables hold ordinary references and ongoing work. Satoru Kanda and Fumito Sakurai can share a problem while Sōichirō Takamine answers focused questions. A consultation does not grant unpublished notebooks.

East Greyfield.basicInfo: The eastern part of Greyfield, a poor settlement outside the city walls to the south. Narrow lanes and close-set homes reflect limited means.

East Greyfield - East Lane.description: A worn lane runs between close-set homes and small street-side workspaces.

East Greyfield - Shared Court.description: A small open yard between buildings serves as a common place for neighbors.

East Greyfield - South Edge.description: The settlement thins toward the road and open ground beyond the walls.

West Greyfield.name: West Greyfield
West Greyfield.basicInfo: The western part of Greyfield, west of East Greyfield. Poor homes and rough lanes continue the settlement outside the southern walls.

West Greyfield - West Lane.description: A rough lane passes patched homes and makeshift workshops.

West Greyfield - Common Yard.description: A shared pocket of open ground sits among the closely packed dwellings.

West Greyfield - Outer Track.description: A path leaves the settlement toward the countryside and western approaches.

Main City Gate.name: Main City Gate
Main City Gate.basicInfo: Glowhaven's largest gate stands at the southernmost edge of the city, forming its main threshold to the south road.

Main City Gate - South Arch.description: The broad central arch carries the heaviest flow of people and carts through the wall.

Main City Gate - Gate Square.description: A paved waiting area on the city side lets travelers gather before passing through.

Main City Gate - Watch Rooms.description: Guard spaces beside the arch overlook the gate and its queues.

Main City Gate - South Road.description: The main road continues south toward Brookmeadow and rural routes.

The Grand Approach.name: The Grand Approach
The Grand Approach.basicInfo: A broad, straight city road running north from the Main City Gate to Four Sages Bazaar. Its long sightline makes it a major public route.

The Grand Approach - South Approach.description: The southern stretch opens onto the broad avenue toward the Main City Gate.

The Grand Approach - Central Walk.description: The straight avenue crosses southern neighborhoods toward the market center.

The Grand Approach - Bazaar Forecourt.description: The northern end opens directly onto Four Sages Bazaar.

The Grand Approach - Gateward Plaza.description: A wide roadside space gives travelers room to pause before entering the avenue.

The Grand Approach - Market Steps.description: The final paved approach meets the market's southern edge.

Briarcrest Manor.name: Briarcrest Manor
Briarcrest Manor.basicInfo: A substantial manor currently for sale. Its formal rooms and grounds are ready to be viewed by prospective buyers.

Briarcrest Manor - Front Walk.description: A straight path crosses the front grounds to the manor's main entrance.

Briarcrest Manor - Entrance Hall.description: A spacious but unoccupied hall introduces the manor's formal interior.

Briarcrest Manor - Reception Rooms.description: Adjoining rooms are arranged for receiving visitors and viewing the property.

Briarcrest Manor - Garden Walk.description: The grounds frame the manor and offer a view of its exterior.

Willowbend Residential District.name: Willowbend Residential District
Willowbend Residential District.basicInfo:
A middle-class and working-class housing district within the city. Everyday services and shared lanes keep it active beyond the workday.

Willowbend Courtyard Cottage is available by agreement: 1200 marks for the property purchase. Ask Nae Komorida to inspect it and confirm the actual terms before paying.

Willowbend Residential District - Willow.description: A residential street passes homes, small workshops, and neighborhood services.

Willowbend Residential District - Courty.description: Several shared courtyards sit behind the street-facing homes.
paths: Willowbend Residential District - Willowbend Courtyard Cottage

Willowbend Residential District - Neighb.description: A small public green offers a place to rest and meet neighbors.

Willowbend Residential District - Willow.description: A small courtyard cottage containing a kitchen, sleeping room, storage loft and narrow garden.

The City Guard patrols streets, investigates ordinary crimes, and makes lawful arrests. Visitors can report incidents, identify recovered property, or ask about summonses.

City Guard Headquarters - Public Entry.description: Tetsuya Ōmi asks for names, places, dates, and what was directly observed. Filing a report does not establish guilt. Property claims require an actual basis.

City Guard Headquarters - Briefing Room.description: A central room supports shift briefings and coordination of city patrols.

City Guard Headquarters - Records Office.description: Desks and shelves hold the headquarters' routine administrative records.

Stargarden Manor.name: Stargarden Manor
Stargarden Manor.basicInfo: The Great Sage's residence. The manor provides private living spaces as well as rooms for receiving a small number of guests.

Stargarden Manor - Front Garden.description: A quiet garden leads to the manor entrance, apart from busier civic streets.

Stargarden Manor - Entrance Hall.description: A composed foyer links guest rooms with the private side of the residence.

Stargarden Manor - Reception Room.description: A comfortable formal room allows the Great Sage to receive visitors at home.

Stargarden Manor - Private Wing.description: The residential rooms are separate from the manor's visitor spaces.

Stargarden Manor - Private Garden.description: A secluded garden offers a quiet outdoor retreat.

The Grand Ascent.name: The Grand Ascent
The Grand Ascent.basicInfo: The monumental staircase rises from Four Sages Bazaar to the Grand Sage's Court. Broad landings break the climb and overlook the city.

The Grand Ascent - Bazaar Foot.description: The bottom of the stairs meets the northern approaches to Four Sages Bazaar.

The Grand Ascent - Lower Flight.description: The first broad flight climbs from market level toward the palace district.

The Grand Ascent - Middle Landing.description: A broad resting platform divides the staircase and overlooks the city.

The Grand Ascent - Upper Flight.description: The final flight leads toward the Grand Sage's Court.

The Grand Ascent - Bazaar Landing.description: A side landing opens toward nearby market approaches.

The Grand Ascent - Palace Landing.description: The top of the ascent opens onto the palace forecourt.

The Wandering Quill.name: The Wandering Quill
The Wandering Quill.basicInfo: A stationery shop serving students, clerks, and anyone who needs paper or writing tools.

The Wandering Quill - Paper and Ink Floo.description: Shelves and counters display paper, ink, pens, and practical writing supplies.

The Wandering Quill - Stock Alcove.description: A small back area holds additional paper goods and boxed supplies.
paths: The Wandering Quill - Paper and Ink Floor

The Wandering Quill - Front Counter.description: The street-facing counter handles purchases and questions.
paths: The Wandering Quill - Paper and Ink Floor

Bramble & Bottle.name: Bramble & Bottle
Bramble & Bottle.basicInfo: A city potion shop where bottled preparations are arranged for browsing and purchase.

Bramble & Bottle - Bottle Gallery.description: Shelves display bottled goods and packaged potion stock behind a clear counter.

Bramble & Bottle - Consultation Counter.description: Customers can ask about the shop's wares at the front counter.

Bramble & Bottle - Preparation Room.description: A work area behind the public shop holds tools and supplies for preparing stock.

The Gilded Griffin.name: The Gilded Griffin
The Gilded Griffin.basicInfo: A fine jewelry shop with polished displays and a formal atmosphere.

The Gilded Griffin - Display Salon.description: Jewelry is presented in carefully lit cases along a quiet customer floor.

The Gilded Griffin - Fitting Desk.description: A private counter lets customers examine pieces and discuss adjustments.

The Gilded Griffin - Front Vestibule.description: The entrance separates the shop's calm interior from the busy street.

Wayfarer's Goods.name: Wayfarer's Goods
Wayfarer's Goods.basicInfo: A city shop for travelers, with practical supplies for road journeys and time away from home.

Wayfarer's Goods - Travel Gear Floor.description: Packs, weather gear, and everyday travel necessities fill the sales room.

Wayfarer's Goods - Packing Counter.description: A long counter offers space to compare gear and prepare a purchase.

Wayfarer's Goods - Supply Room.description: Boxes and reserve stock are kept behind the public shop floor.

Crooked Tankard.name: Crooked Tankard
Crooked Tankard.basicInfo: Benji Takarada's taproom is loud enough for laughter and arranged well enough for a quiet hearth-side conversation. It serves meals, drinks, introductions, and occasional paid help with a busy evening. A filling meal costs 3 marks and a modest drink 2.

Crooked Tankard - Taproom.description: The main tavern room centers on the bar, with conversation and the clatter of cups.

Crooked Tankard - Hearth Corner.description: A warm seating nook beside the fire offers a quieter spot.

Crooked Tankard - Side Room.description: A smaller room off the main floor gives groups some separation from busy tables.

Crooked Tankard - Kitchen Passage.description: The service passage links the public room with the food-preparation area.

Roseberry Inn.basicInfo:
Supper reaches the common room before its plates do. Noriko Hanesawa offers beds, meals, directions, and limited introductions to people who use her inn. A shared bunk costs 6 marks and a plain private room 12 per night. Noriko Hanesawa can arrange paid afternoon room turnover and common-room work around a student timetable.

Roseberry Inn - Front Desk.description: The entrance and reception desk connect the street with shared rooms.

Roseberry Inn - Common Room.description: Visitors may eat, rest, exchange public news, and arrange meetings. A courteous introduction does not make every guest a quest giver. Bills and promised rooms remain relevant until settled.

Roseberry Inn - Dining Room.description: A simple dining space serves guests and visitors.

Roseberry Inn - Guest Stair.description: The staircase leads toward the inn's overnight rooms.

Roseberry Inn - Kitchen Passage.description: A service corridor links the dining room with the inn's working spaces.

Roseberry Inn - Roseberry Attic Room.description: A compact private attic room with a bed, washstand, locking chest and writing table under the eaves.

Roseberry Inn - Cellar.description: Broad wooden steps lead into a low, cool cellar smelling of flour and apple skins. Sack shelves, a work stool and spare boards flank a clear central aisle; a small ground-level vent lets in a strip of daylight.

Driftstone Isle.name: Driftstone Isle
Driftstone Isle.basicInfo: An inhabited island off Glowhaven's coast, with a small community linked to the water and rocky ground.

Driftstone Isle - Island Landing.description: A sheltered landing connects boats with the island's main footpath.

Driftstone Isle - Village Lane.description: The main path passes homes and small shared yards.

Driftstone Isle - Village Green.description: A modest open space serves as a gathering point among the island homes.

Driftstone Isle - Rocky Shore.description: A rough stretch of coast offers views across the water and stony island edge.

Pinewake Coast.name: Pinewake Coast
Pinewake Coast.basicInfo: A stretch of coast where pines meet the shoreline, with open views across the water and quiet places along the beach. The tide pools and headland have slippery stone, incoming water and occasional loose rock. A dry upper approach is safer than treating every exposed shelf as a permanent path.

Pinewake Coast - Pineward Beach.description: A sandy shoreline lies beneath the first line of coastal pines.

Pinewake Coast - Tide Pools.description: Shallow pools sit among the rocks along the coast. The tide pools and headland have slippery stone, incoming water and occasional loose rock. A dry upper approach is safer than treating every exposed shelf as a permanent path.

Pinewake Coast - Pine Headland.description: A low wooded rise overlooks the shore and nearby waters.

Clovermead.name: Clovermead
Clovermead.basicInfo: A distant farming settlement north of the city, with a few houses among broad fields. It is reached by boat rather than an ordinary city road.

Clovermead - Boat Landing.description: A simple landing provides access from the water to scattered farmsteads.

Clovermead - Farm Lane.description: A narrow track connects the houses and working plots.

Clovermead - Farmstead Green.description: A small shared space sits among the settlement's few homes.

Clovermead - Meadow Fields.description: Open farmland stretches away from the houses toward quieter edges.

Pebblewick.name: Pebblewick
Pebblewick.basicInfo: A small coastal town outside Glowhaven's walls, set near the shore and close to the water.

Pebblewick - Shore Road.description: The coastal road passes homes and small businesses.

Pebblewick - Pebblewick Green.description: A modest open square gives residents and visitors a meeting point.

Pebblewick - Village Lane.description: A short lane runs between homes and everyday services.

Pebblewick - Boat Landing.description: Small vessels can reach the town from the nearby shore.

Crescent Shores.name: Crescent Shores
Crescent Shores.basicInfo: The eastern beaches form a curved stretch of open shoreline, with dunes and sheltered coves along the coast.

Crescent Shores - Crescent Beach.description: A broad arc of sand follows the curve of the coast.

Crescent Shores - Dune Path.description: A sandy trail runs along low dunes above the beach.

Crescent Shores - Sheltered Cove.description: A quieter inlet is screened from open water by rocky points.

Crescent Shores - Coastal Bluff.description: A low rise offers a view along the beaches and across the water.

Seabreeze Inn.name: Seabreeze Inn
Seabreeze Inn.basicInfo: An inn in Pebblewick where visitors can find a meal and an overnight room close to the coast.

Seabreeze Inn - Reception.description: The entrance desk welcomes travelers and connects the shared spaces.

Seabreeze Inn - Common Room.description: A bright shared room offers seating and meals with sea air close by.

Seabreeze Inn - Dining Room.description: A compact room serves guests and local visitors.

Seabreeze Inn - Guest Landing.description: An upstairs corridor leads to the inn's overnight rooms.

Seabreeze Inn - Kitchen Door.description: A service doorway connects the dining space to the working kitchen.

Glowhaven Farmlands.name: Glowhaven Farmlands
Glowhaven Farmlands.basicInfo: Grain, vegetables and irrigation strips spread beyond Greyfield and the southern city roads. Takumi Hatano organizes shared channel work, seasonal labor and produce arrangements among the growers.

Glowhaven Farmlands - South Fields.description: Open plots extend toward the rural road, divided by low fences and footpaths.

Glowhaven Farmlands - Farm Track.description: A compacted path links field edges and nearby farms.

Glowhaven Farmlands - Irrigation Run.description: A narrow watercourse passes between cultivated plots.

Glowhaven Farmlands - Brookmeadow Edge.description: The farmland thins toward the road and homes around Brookmeadow.

Hermit's hut - Mountain Trail.description: A steep, wooded path climbs through trees toward the hut.

Hermit's hut - Hut Clearing.description: A small open patch reveals the hut among the mountain trees.

Hermit's hut - Hut Interior.description: The modest interior is sheltered and plainly furnished, with forest close outside.

Pinewater River.name: Pinewater River
Pinewater River.basicInfo: Pinewater winds through the wooded valley south of Glowhaven’s western wards. Bridges, working banks and shallow resting places link Pebbletown with the surrounding farms.

Pinewater River - Brookmeadow Ford.description: A shallow crossing gives nearby residents a practical route across the river.

Pinewater River - River Bend.description: The water curves around a quiet bank with stones and grass at the edge.

West Glowhaven Woods - Woodland Edge.description: The forest begins beyond the open ground outside the west gate.

West Glowhaven Woods - Pine Track.description: A shaded path winds among trees and undergrowth.

West Glowhaven Woods - Clearing.description: A quiet patch of open ground breaks the trees and gives a view back toward the city. The outer track is commonly used. Pebbletown - Southwest Lane.description: The road enters town past homes and small work yards.

Pebbletown - Town Green.description: A simple common sits at the center of the settlement.

Pebbletown - Market Corner.description: A few local stalls and storefronts face the town's main route.

Sage's Spire.name: Sage's Spire
Sage's Spire.basicInfo: The Great Sage's tower and office. Workrooms and private meeting spaces give the Sage a place to manage civic and Evertree affairs.

Sage's Spire - Spire Entrance.description: The tower's ground floor receives official visitors and connects to upper workspaces.

Sage's Spire - Office Landing.description: A stair landing links the entrance with the Great Sage's principal office.

Sage's Spire - Great Sage's Office.description: The main workroom contains a desk and space for managing official business.

Sage's Spire - Records Room.description: Shelves and desks hold working papers and reference materials.

Sage's Spire - Meeting Room.description: A private room supports smaller discussions away from public halls.

Violet Thread.name: Violet Thread

Customers can seek repairs, practical academy clothing, formal commissions, and alterations based on how an outfit will actually be used. Reika Saionji's commercial interests do not make her permanently present at the counter.

Violet Thread - Clothing Floor.description: Racks and display tables present the shop's current clothing selection.

Violet Thread - Fitting Alcove.description: A fitting requires cooperation and privacy. Minor repairs normally cost 5–12 marks; larger changes receive a separate quote. Professional care does not establish romantic contact.

Violet Thread - Front Counter.description: The street-facing counter handles purchases and questions.

Delivering a pattern, negotiating another appointment, finding a willing second craftsperson, or accepting a simpler finish can help. The Golden Ladle - Main Hall.description: The spacious tavern floor fills with workers, long tables, and lively conversation.

The Golden Ladle - Bar.description: A broad counter serves the main hall and keeps the room's activity in motion.

The Golden Ladle - Workers' Room.description: A side room offers additional seating for groups and regulars.

The Golden Ladle - Kitchen Passage.description: The service route links the public hall with the working kitchen.

The Farmer's Exchange - Market Stalls.description: Rows of stalls display fresh produce and other farm goods.

The Farmer's Exchange - Trading Walk.description: A broad lane between stalls gives shoppers and sellers room to pass and bargain.

Moonwhisker Emporium - Care Counter.description: Visitors can ask about familiar care, summoned companions, or everyday pet supplies at the central counter.
