Threadfall Galleries - Lower Stair.description: A split stair runs down the right wall toward a deeper pool of turquoise light. Bronze clips lead the eye to repaired machinery below. The approved route continues into Sunken Broodworks across the map seam; this landing is not another map location.

Sunken Broodworks.name: Sunken Broodworks
Sunken Broodworks.basicInfo: The second chamber is a flooded workshop of low stone platforms, bronze winches and silver-draped arches. Water turns slowly beneath a guarded span; intact gears pulse when strands tighten somewhere below. Beyond a wall of geometric thread marks, a dense lattice screens the matron’s gate. The air smells of damp mineral and warm metal. The descent continues here, rather than opening into another dungeon or settlement.
Sunken Broodworks.hiddenInfo: CHALLENGE: Secure the Guarded Span or a real alternative and make the Matron Gate passable. Three arachne span defenders work together, a spider pack occupies the Lower Winch and two gatekeepers hold the Matron Gate. Use the type-based area-entry encounters and their actual runtime identities, distinct from Vhalessra. Each group can be fought, distracted, credibly negotiated past where sapient, or actually bypassed. Preserve individual states and do not pull every group into one encounter. The Lower Winch controls a tension cradle, not a magical password. The Pattern Wall shows matching three-part load marks: observe the pulse, release the cradle between pulses and pin the slack line. Sound reasoning, careful tools, Force or suitable learned magic can implement a viable method. Severing a live bundle carelessly risks a visible recoil; attempting it still requires an outcome. A real safe alternate around the lattice also qualifies. Do not require every side area or every enemy death. The Rest Ledge permits observation from cover. Experimental anchor filaments and a piece of foreign transit metal establish how the apparatus snagged another route, not that the Evertree is dying. Actual secured passage opens Widow’s Crucible permanently; no reset on return.

Sunken Broodworks - Water Shelf.description: The upper stair ends above ankle-deep mineral water. Ripples reveal the patrol’s approach before its legs reach the platforms. Raised stones offer a dry staging point and a clear path back; the first chamber remains immediately up the stairs.

Sunken Broodworks - Guarded Span.description: A narrow platform crosses the turning water toward the main winch. Silver trip-lines show where the broodwarden watches. The water’s reflection and its actual patrol rhythm may support distraction or evasion; combat does not start with unavoidable damage.

Sunken Broodworks - Lower Winch.description: A bronze drum winds three lines around a stone cradle. A worn handle and locking pin are usable physical mechanisms. Turning against a loaded pulse is difficult; observing the Pattern Wall or supporting the cradle can make the same work manageable.

Sunken Broodworks - Rest Ledge.description: A dry recess behind a split pillar hides the party from the span without erasing its noises or scent. Old silk samples cling to matching load marks. A narrow lip reaches the Pattern Wall if it is actually traversed; it is an alternative approach, not an instant teleport.

Sunken Broodworks - Pattern Wall.description: Three repeated marks show a load cradle rising, slackening and being pinned. New silver strands run over much older carved instructions. Studying this tangible sequence can support a workable gate method; copying symbols alone does not solve the machinery. Deeper impressions show a much larger body and old spear impacts from the queen’s guard; heat has blistered the lower metal. These are warnings of a substantially stronger defended chamber, not a promise of a fair solo duel.

Sunken Broodworks - Matron Gate.description: A curtain of taut silver lattice fills the narrow descent into the warm crucible. Slackening and securing the line, or resolving another viable access method, makes it a stable two-way route. Beyond it stands the actual matron’s chamber; there is no second queen behind a hidden deeper door.

Widow's Crucible.name: Widow's Crucible
Widow's Crucible.basicInfo: The lowest chamber is a circular crucible of dark stone, ember-lit vents and silver anchor lines. Thick pillars divide an outer ring from a raised weaving dais. Vhalessra intercepts humanoid outsiders here with open hostility, using the chamber’s strands and sight lines to defend her apparatus. A broken cradle behind the dais gathers the converging threads. The stairs back remain real and usable.
Widow's Crucible.hiddenInfo:
Use the sole authored boss Vhalessra, level 45, initial relationship -85. The entry trigger brings her to the actual arrival area after the lower passage is earned; do not replace her with a generated queen. She blocks, threatens and attacks intruders who press on, but an actual defense, retreat or credible parley is possible. Raised ribs and pillars provide real cover; heated vents give visible warnings before a hazardous maneuver. Her Nature and Fire magic and learned techniques govern the encounter, with no arbitrary immunity or second phase. The central web-anchor is her experiment for reaching beyond the chasm; a damaged foreign transit fitting and strain scars corroborate the accidental route snag. Native defeat or genuine achieved surrender awards the exact Matron’s Anchor Sigil through the existing typed grant, once. Preserve death or nonlethal state; no finishing-blow loop, substitute loot or trophy seizure. The apparatus can then be studied for the received court report. Do not invent another boss, reset cleared rooms or close the return route.

Kharvess and Orrhask are the queen’s two unique finite retainers, placed by the encounter trigger. The queen’s explicit level 45 overrides the ordinary 27-32 local minion band. Preserve these established levels independently of player level. The open ascent, cover and signs of superior force encourage withdrawal or returning with companions.

Widow's Crucible - Outer Ring.description: Substantial pillars break the line of sight from the entry stair to the dais. Vhalessra intercepts intruders at their actual entry area with threats and preparations to bind or attack. There is room to take cover, defend, withdraw or attempt credible parley; no opening hit is automatic.

Widow's Crucible - Weaving Dais.description: Silver lines converge around a raised disk above slow ember vents. The matron works through a silver-edged spindle and the actual anchor apparatus. Low stone ribs can interrupt a direct rush or provide a flank; the pattern’s visible tension gives attentive opponents useful information.

Widow's Crucible - Anchor Recess.description: A counterweight cradle holds strain-fractured silver-black fittings. A silver-black fragment can break free when the matron’s hold on the web-anchor is overcome. Scoring, silk traces and a foreign transit fitting can support a specific report. Nothing here steals souls or erases the home passage.

Crescent Crown Fortress.name: Crescent Crown Fortress
Crescent Crown Fortress.basicInfo: The capital's upper stronghold occupies the higher northeastern shelf, reached by a rising, guarded approach. Thick pale-gray walls, square towers and practical slate roofs enclose courts, stores and offices. An enormous dragon skeleton curves around the stronghold's outer rock, making fortress and remains a single unmistakable landmark. The Jarl's Hall, Clans' Assembly House and Crescent Sanctuary occupy distinct precincts of this larger complex. Visitors come with petitions, official business or permission to see the public courts; the fortress is a working seat of government rather than an extravagant palace.
Crescent Crown Fortress.hiddenInfo: Outer courts can be busy without granting access to stores, command rooms or private apartments. Repair crews must respect both defensive masonry and the sacred remains beyond it. A difficult allocation of labor between a damaged wall and lower-city snow clearance offers a credible civic dispute, not automatic treason.

Crescent Crown Fortress - Ascending Appr.description: A zigzag stone approach climbs from the lower city to the upper shelf, its parapets broken by sheltered passing bays. Couriers, carts and visitors share the route. From below, the ancestral ribs appear beyond the walls like another range of pale cliffs.

Crescent Crown Fortress - Outer Arch.description: A deep archway narrows entry beneath heavy gates. Guards direct public visitors toward the court and examine freight destined for government stores. Their ordinary work is traffic, access and weather readiness; a portal credential is not a fortress appointment.

Crescent Crown Fortress - Public Court.description: Packed snow surrounds a cleared square between administrative buildings. Petitioners wait near a roofed notice wall, while laborers cross with timber and coal. Signs and attendants distinguish the routes toward the Jarl's Hall, assembly precinct and sanctuary.

Crescent Crown Fortress - Stores Passage.description: A vaulted corridor connects locked grain, fuel and equipment stores. Ventilation grilles breathe cold air across numbered doors. Deliveries are weighed here, and access depends on the actual job; scarcity cannot be solved merely by declaring the shelves full.

Crescent Crown Fortress - Inner Ward.description: A smaller guarded court separates offices from private residential rooms. Plain windows and covered walks speak of warmth and security rather than ceremonial grandeur. Authorized messengers wait under the eaves instead of wandering into the Jarl's household.

Crescent Crown Fortress - Rampart Walk.description: An inspected stretch of wall overlooks the lower roofs and neighboring peaks. Public access depends on weather and duty. The sacred skeleton lies outside the masonry; nobody uses its bones as a railing or convenient source of building material.

The Ancestor's Crescent.name: The Ancestor's Crescent
The Ancestor's Crescent.basicInfo:
The remains of the ancient protector lie in a vast crescent around the northeastern fortress shelf. Weathered ribs rise above stone walkways, the spine follows the mountain's curve, and the skull rests on a broad natural ledge. The founders sheltered under this dragon's protection when they were close to dying on the mountain; their descendants regard the remains as sacred history. The bones define the city's silhouette but do not generate its heat or mana. Keepers maintain respectful viewing paths and support fragile sections without turning the skeleton into a public climbing frame.

People associated with this place include: Keishin Tōdō — Crescent archivist and conservator; Miharu Sakuraba — Sacred-bone conservation craftswoman.
The Ancestor's Crescent.hiddenInfo: This is a protected resting place, not a relic quarry. Wind and frost can loosen scree around a support pier, giving conservators practical work without implying the ancestor is awakening. Offerings belong to the sanctuary's custody until properly placed or removed. The dragon's actual personal name has not been established.

The Ancestor's Crescent - Pilgrims' Appr.description: A broad stair ends at a low stone boundary where visitors brush snow from their boots. The first ribs loom beyond a turn in the path, larger than the buildings below. Keepers explain which sections can be approached safely.

The Ancestor's Crescent - Rib Walk.description: A paved route follows the outside of the rib cage behind a modest rail. Prayer ribbons hang from separate wooden frames, never nailed into the bones. Quiet conversation mixes with wind passing through the enormous spaces between the ribs. Miharu Sakuraba is usually based here, working as sacred-bone conservation craftswoman.

The Ancestor's Crescent - Skull Overlook.description: The skull lies beyond a respectful viewing distance on its rock shelf. Visitors leave lamps at a stone stand, with the fortress rising behind the curve of bone. The overlook offers no ordinary passage into the skull or beneath its unstable edges.

The Ancestor's Crescent - Spine Terrace.description: A sheltered terrace follows a section of vertebrae half-buried in old snow. Carved plaques recount the founders' refuge and later settlement. The path is useful for slow historical walks, remembrance and observation of the surrounding masonry.

The Ancestor's Crescent - Conservators'.description: Brushes, survey notes and temporary braces fill a low maintenance shelter. Keepers and stoneworkers compare cracks and snow loads before work begins. A visiting researcher can ask to examine the records; study of the remains requires actual permission. Keishin Tōdō is usually based here, working as crescent archivist and conservator.

The Ancestor's Crescent - Windward Bound.description: A final low wall closes the public route before exposed scree and cliff. Warning markers are practical, not a challenge to prove devotion. Beyond it, the bones continue around the rock where only trained maintenance parties venture.

The Jarl's Hall.name: The Jarl's Hall
The Jarl's Hall.basicInfo:
A long, sturdy hall within Crescent Crown Fortress houses the Jarl's public business. Dark beams, clan banners and a broad central hearth provide ceremony without lavish palace ornament. The Jarl is elected through the clan chiefs rather than inheriting an unquestionable throne, and governs a country whose clans retain substantial local influence. Petitioners seek decisions on roads, trade, defense and disputes beyond a single household. Access to a hearing depends on business and availability; being an impressive visitor does not automatically secure an audience.

People associated with this place include: Daizen Iwatsugu — Jarl of Drakenspire and chief of Clan Iwatsugu.
The Jarl's Hall.hiddenInfo: The office must negotiate support from chiefs, merchants and military leaders. A petition can be legitimate while competing with equally real needs elsewhere. Do not create an incumbent's name, family or secret allegiance merely to fill the room; establish a recurring person only when the story actually requires one.

The Jarl's Hall - Petition Porch.description: A sheltered porch holds benches, a public notice board and a table for sorting requests. A clerk distinguishes urgent harm from ordinary appointments. Visitors can learn the procedure without surrendering every detail of a private dispute to the waiting crowd.

The Jarl's Hall - Hearth Hall.description: The audience hall centers on an open hearth and raised working seat, with clan banners overhead. Hearings have witnesses, interruptions and practical limits. The room may be between sessions; an empty seat is not proof of a missing ruler. Daizen Iwatsugu is usually based here, working as jarl of drakenspire and chief of clan iwatsugu.

The Jarl's Hall - Council Chamber.description: A smaller chamber accommodates negotiations that need maps, accounts or difficult compromise. Thick shutters soften the wind against the fortress. Invitations matter here, and a public petition does not confer attendance at every closed discussion.

The Jarl's Hall - Records Room.description: Shelved copies of judgments, commitments and correspondence preserve the government's memory. Clerks retrieve relevant records according to access and condition. A public ruling can be consulted without exposing private testimony or giving visitors ownership of the documents.

Clans' Assembly House.name: Clans' Assembly House
Clans' Assembly House.basicInfo:
A broad stone chamber beside the fortress court provides neutral ground for the chiefs' deliberations and the election of the Jarl. Carved seats face an open speaking floor; the room is practical enough for ordinary budgeting as well as solemn decisions. Clan autonomy makes agreement necessary, while merchants and military leaders exert influence through testimony, resources and reputation. The assembly is not always in session. Residents come to hear public business, submit a grievance or learn which authority can actually resolve it.

People associated with this place include: Shūhei Iwatsugu — Clan Iwatsugu works surveyor and aspiring expedition leader; Noboru Ōhira — Clan Assembly recorder.
Clans' Assembly House.hiddenInfo: The country has more clans than the three prominent houses mapped in the capital. Do not invent a fixed electoral timetable, a universal vote for every merchant or an automatic hereditary successor. A chief's public position may reflect genuine duties to dependents rather than a single private grudge.

Clans' Assembly House - Delegates' Court.description: Clan messengers and witnesses wait beside stone benches and a covered water stand. Public notices identify the day's business. The court is a place for conversation and preparation, not an automatic invitation to overhear confidential bargaining. Shūhei Iwatsugu is usually based here, working as clan iwatsugu works surveyor and aspiring expedition leader.

Clans' Assembly House - Speaking Floor.description: A clear central floor faces the chiefs' benches. Speakers present claims, answer objections and refer to actual evidence. Disagreement can end in adjournment or compromise; every debate need not become a duel, election or national crisis.

Clans' Assembly House - Witness Gallery.description: An upper gallery accommodates permitted observers and people awaiting a call to testify. The low ceiling traps the warmth of the chamber below. Whispered commentary travels easily, and a visitor's interpretation is not the same as the assembly's decision.

Clans' Assembly House - Charter Room.description: Bound agreements, route obligations and old settlements are kept in plain cupboards. Custodians help locate a relevant clause while protecting fragile originals. Learning the law is possible here; changing a document does not change every copy or everyone's recollection. Noboru Ōhira is usually based here, working as clan assembly recorder.

Crescent Sanctuary.name: Crescent Sanctuary
Crescent Sanctuary.basicInfo:
This restrained sanctuary faces the ancestral bones from the fortress precinct. Its faith honors dragons as sacred beings and ancestors as people whose shelter, labor and choices made the present possible. Lamps, stone reliefs and woven memorial cloths fill a low, warm interior. Keepers conduct remembrance, receive offerings and teach the founding account. Outsiders may ask questions or sit respectfully without pretending belief. Religious observance shapes public life, but individual residents differ in devotion, interpretation and patience with ceremony.

People associated with this place include: Seika Amatsune — First Keeper of the Crescent.
Crescent Sanctuary.hiddenInfo:
Keepers preserve traditions rather than provide guaranteed dragon audiences or miraculous answers. An offering can express gratitude without purchasing protection. Disagreement over a festival expenditure or the conservation of a fragile object can be sincere on both sides; the institution is not secretly corrupt by default.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: First Ascent: A Light for the Cairns. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

Crescent Sanctuary - Lamp Porch.description: Sheltered stone niches hold lamps protected from the wind. Visitors pause here to warm their hands and ask about the day's observances. Public notices distinguish memorial gatherings from ordinary visiting hours without treating every outsider as a suspect.

Crescent Sanctuary - Hall of Refuge.description: Reliefs show exhausted founders beneath a protecting dragon, followed by the first shelters and workings. A central aisle leaves space for quiet gatherings. The story is told as the community's foundation, not a prophecy identifying the newest traveler. Seika Amatsune is usually based here, working as first keeper of the crescent.

Crescent Sanctuary - Offering Chamber.description: Covered tables receive food, cloth and other accepted gifts before their proper disposition. Keepers record significant offerings and prevent spoiled provisions from accumulating. Gifts intended for a living dragon do not guarantee that one will arrive to take them.

Crescent Sanctuary - Memorial Alcove.description: Small family tokens rest beside names and dates in a softly lit recess. People speak to their dead, sit silently or share a remembered meal nearby. These objects are personal memorials, not random magical treasure.

Crescent Sanctuary - Keepers' Workroom.description: Repair thread, festival schedules and conservation notes crowd a practical workroom. Volunteers can ask about specific tasks. The sanctuary's care includes sweeping, recordkeeping and coordination with stoneworkers as much as public ritual.

Ancestor Cairn Terrace.name: Ancestor Cairn Terrace
Ancestor Cairn Terrace.basicInfo: Low cairns and family memorial stones occupy a sheltered terrace below the sacred crescent. Paths remain broad enough for winter funeral processions, with places to rest out of the wind. This is a living place of remembrance, used by clan households and residents without grand lineage alike. Visitors may trace local history through inscriptions or accompany someone paying respects. The terrace is peaceful more often than eventful; grief and ordinary care need no supernatural revelation to matter.
Ancestor Cairn Terrace.hiddenInfo: Family accounts can disagree with formal clan histories. Access to a memorial does not make private letters or offerings available for looting. A damaged inscription can lead to restoration work with the family's permission, not the automatic discovery of a hidden royal bloodline.

Ancestor Cairn Terrace - Procession Gate.description: A broad stone gate opens onto paths swept after snowfall. Covered benches allow mourners to gather before continuing. Flowers, evergreen sprigs and wool wraps appear according to the season and household, rather than one universal ritual.

Ancestor Cairn Terrace - Family Cairns.description: Low mounds and engraved stones mark generations of residents. Some names are freshly cut; others have almost weathered away. Visitors can read public inscriptions, while private grief belongs to the people present rather than to a compulsory quest.
paths: Ancestor Cairn Terrace - Sheltered Remembrance Bench

Ancestor Cairn Terrace - Common Memorial.description: A plain wall remembers people whose families could not maintain a separate monument. Workmates and neighbors leave small lamps here. Its care reflects shared civic responsibility as well as religious custom.
paths: Ancestor Cairn Terrace - Sheltered Remembrance Bench

Ancestor Cairn Terrace - Sheltered Remem.description: A curved wall shields a line of benches overlooking the lower city. This is a quiet place to talk, eat a small packed meal or sit without speaking. The sound of festival drums can occasionally drift up from far below.

High Rampart Gate.name: High Rampart Gate
High Rampart Gate.basicInfo:
A fortified gatehouse controls the road from the inhabited lower shelf to the northeastern fortress precinct. It combines a switchback, inspection arch and sheltered waiting yard so winter traffic can be handled without blocking the entire ascent. Guards check appointments, dangerous loads and current restrictions. Ordinary people have business here—deliveries, petitions, repair work and religious visits—while access to military interiors remains separate. The gate's importance comes from its position, not from elaborate magical spectacle.

People associated with this place include: Reina Tachibana — Captain of the Upper Ward and fortress inspections; Hayate Mizusawa — Upper gate guard.
High Rampart Gate.hiddenInfo: A snow closure should have a visible reason and a practical review, not an arbitrary bribe demand. Guards enforce actual orders and distinguish a visitor's rank from local authority. A damaged cart or absent permit can create a solvable delay without making every officer hostile.

High Rampart Gate - Lower Switchback.description: A winding approach gives carts room to climb the grade without a straight charge at the gate. Snow poles mark the outside edge. People on foot use the inner steps and can see the lower city expanding beneath them.

High Rampart Gate - Inspection Arch.description: Under the heavy arch, guards compare visitors' stated business with the access being requested. There is room to stand aside while a delivery is checked. The inspection concerns the fortress; it does not revoke valid portal travel by implication. Hayate Mizusawa is usually based here, working as upper gate guard.

High Rampart Gate - Waiting Yard.description: A roofed edge of the yard shelters people delayed by weather or appointments. A brazier and posted notices keep waiting tolerable. Conversations here can reveal practical concerns, though nobody knows all government business merely from standing in line.

High Rampart Gate - Watchroom.description: The duty room holds route boards, spare cloaks and current orders. Entry requires a reason to speak privately with the watch. The staffing and readiness of a working gate persist after the player leaves. Reina Tachibana is usually based here, working as captain of the upper ward and fortress inspections.

Oathward Barracks.name: Oathward Barracks
Oathward Barracks.basicInfo:
Plain stone barracks house the hold's guard detachments and their equipment. A courtyard permits drill without turning the lower streets into a training ground. The force protects gates, patrols public roads and responds to violence; it is answerable to local government, not a branch of Glowhaven's strikeforce. Visitors can report danger, deliver supplies or inquire about lawful work at the duty entrance. Sleeping quarters, weapons stores and operational records remain restricted.

People associated with this place include: Gōki Shishido — Commander of the Drakenspire Hold Guard.
Oathward Barracks.hiddenInfo: The guard's competence varies by actual person, but the city is not defenseless because one patrol is busy. Resource tensions include winter equipment, road escorts and gate staffing. A credible report can change patrol priorities; an unsupported boast does not automatically mobilize the garrison.

Oathward Barracks - Duty Entrance.description: A small counter receives reports, deliveries and requests to speak with the watch. Wet cloaks steam on hooks behind it. Urgency is assessed from what happened and where, with witnesses and injuries treated as evidence rather than theatrical proof.

Oathward Barracks - Drill Court.description: Packed gravel and snow cleared from the center leave space for formation work and practical exercises. Racks hold training equipment during supervised use. The court is a workplace, not an open arena for challenging every guard. Gōki Shishido is usually based here, working as commander of the drakenspire hold guard.
paths: Oathward Barracks - Mess and Rest Wing

Oathward Barracks - Equipment Stores.description: Locked cupboards contain winter gear, maintained weapons and repair supplies. Issuing an item requires an actual assignment or authorized transaction. Issued equipment is logged, and shortages can delay an assignment.

Oathward Barracks - Mess and Rest Wing.description: Long tables and adjoining sleeping rooms accommodate off-duty personnel. The atmosphere is tired and ordinary between shifts. Access follows an invitation or official need; uniforms do not remove privacy or the need to rest.

Dragonwatch Balcony.name: Dragonwatch Balcony
Dragonwatch Balcony.basicInfo:
A broad sheltered lookout on the upper rock faces the high ranges. Residents watch changing clouds, distant wings and the paths by which trouble may approach. The gray guardian is occasionally seen far overhead, and such a sight draws serious attention, but the balcony is usually a quiet place for weather watching and conversation. It gives no view of a confirmed dragon lair. Visitors can compare sighting records, sketch the mountain skyline or simply appreciate the city below.

People associated with this place include: Kotoha Umezaki — Dragonwatch observer and weather diarist.
Dragonwatch Balcony.hiddenInfo:
A distant shape must not be identified with impossible certainty. The guardian's appearance can be a warning without specifying the threat, and absence promises no safety. Sighting records can support patterns, not an exact population count or a reliable schedule of dragon visits.

Rare authored contact: Rovakthuun begins off-stage. The actual rare-contact trigger controls a first physical appearance; looking for the being, purchasing a rumor or clicking this location is not proof of arrival. Do not generate a replacement, public lair or guaranteed meeting. Ordinary weather, tracks and fieldwork remain valid scenes.

Dragonwatch Balcony - Wind Screen.description: A thick wall breaks the prevailing wind before the open viewing edge. Hooks hold communal weather notices, and a narrow bench gives tired climbers a rest. Heavy snow can make the exposed part of the balcony unsuitable for lingering.

Dragonwatch Balcony - Sky Rail.description: A stone rail frames the jagged skyline above the city. On a clear day a watcher can follow distant movement for a long time. No observation here automatically reveals a creature's motives, identity or home.

Dragonwatch Balcony - Sighting Nook.description: A dry recess holds copied reports of unusual flights, weather and mountain disturbances. Dates and witness descriptions are kept distinct from interpretation. Comparing two accounts can be useful research without proving a new prophecy. Kotoha Umezaki is usually based here, working as dragonwatch observer and weather diarist.

Dragonwatch Balcony - City View.description: The lower roofs, procession streets and forge smoke spread below the balcony. It is an easy place to understand the city's two elevations. The immense bones remain close enough to anchor the view without becoming a bridge between districts.

Founders' Processional Way.name: Founders' Processional Way
Founders' Processional Way.basicInfo: A wide, gently stepped street cuts across the lower shelf, linking household districts with the central market and the ascent toward the sacred precinct. It is kept broad for dragon festivals, ancestor processions and ordinary freight. Wool banners and painted shutters provide color against snow and dark stone. Most days bring shoppers and deliveries; festival days bring food stalls, music and communal preparations. The street allows Drakenspire to be lively without turning every resident into a solemn warrior.
Founders' Processional Way.hiddenInfo: Festival arrangements are work: access, waste, carts, music and neighbors all need accommodation. A clash between a stallholder and a procession organizer can be resolved through space and timing. Decorations do not confirm that a festival is occurring today unless the scene establishes it.

Founders' Processional Way - Banner Step.description: Broad shallow steps descend between stone posts hung with seasonal cloth. Ramps along the edges carry handcarts and accommodate travelers who cannot use the steps comfortably. The posts mark a familiar meeting place rather than a formal checkpoint.

Founders' Processional Way - Procession.description: A widened section of street gives musicians and ceremonial groups room to form. Outside events, children, residents and delivery workers use the same open ground. Portable stands are stored away instead of occupying the square permanently.

Founders' Processional Way - Stall Reces.description: Recessed shopfronts can hold temporary festival counters without blocking the main route. Vendors negotiate space and cleanup with organizers. On an ordinary day the recesses shelter quiet businesses and people waiting out a flurry.

Founders' Processional Way - Carvers' Co.description: A sheltered corner displays repaired dragon masks, wooden ornaments and memorial boards. Artisans work on commissions in public view. Customers can discuss a design or watch careful handwork without every object being enchanted.

Hearthmarket Square.name: Hearthmarket Square
Hearthmarket Square.basicInfo:
The main lower-city market fills an irregular square with stone arcades and removable stalls. Butchers, wool sellers, household traders and carriers serve residents as well as visitors. Imported vegetables and grain arrive through trade alongside local meat, cheese and preserved food. The square provides shopping, small errands and news from the mountains, with public scales used to settle ordinary disputes. Its importance is daily exchange; a trip here can remain a pleasant errand.

People associated with this place include: Sachie Handa — Hearthmarket butcher; Eitarō Handa — Dairy seller and wool broker.
Hearthmarket Square.hiddenInfo: Weather can change availability and explain a quote, but not justify invented currency systems or arbitrary scarcity every visit. A short weight, damaged delivery or misplaced purchase creates specific stakes. Ownership, agreed prices and actual payment remain separate from browsing.

Hearthmarket Square - Covered Arcade.description: Stone arches shelter shops selling household goods and durable winter supplies. Meltwater runs in a channel outside the walking line. Customers compare quality and price while residents pause to exchange news with familiar traders.
paths: Hearthmarket Square - Wool and Dairy Stalls

Hearthmarket Square - Butchers' Row.description: Cold counters display prepared meat beside covered chopping blocks and hanging scales. Practical cleanliness matters as much as generous portions. Offcuts, orders and delivery times can support ordinary work without turning the stalls into a monster-part bazaar. Sachie Handa is usually based here, working as hearthmarket butcher.

Hearthmarket Square - Wool and Dairy Sta.description: Bundles of yarn, sheep cheese and wrapped provisions share a sheltered stretch. Local households sell alongside larger traders. The scent of wool and salt is interrupted by hot broth carried through the crowd. Eitarō Handa is usually based here, working as dairy seller and wool broker.

Hearthmarket Square - Public Scales.description: A roofed weighing table allows traders and customers to verify substantial loads. The attendant's task is measurement, not deciding every contractual dispute. An accurate weight can still leave a question about quality, damage or promised delivery.

Hearthmarket Square - Freight Lane.description: A narrow service lane lets loaded carts reach the rear of shops. Pedestrians yield when a team backs into a bay. Missing labels or an overloaded cart create practical problems with recognizable owners, rather than free crates to open.
paths: Hearthmarket Square - Wool and Dairy Stalls

Snowmelt Residential Steps.name: Snowmelt Residential Steps
Snowmelt Residential Steps.basicInfo:
Close-set stone homes climb the lower shelf in rows broken by shared stairs and drainage runs. Shutters, wool curtains and patched roofs show households living through long winters. This is a residential neighborhood rather than a public dungeon: visitors come to meet someone, rent a room or do an agreed repair. Neighbors share snow clearance and news, with friendliness varying by person. The upper fortress is visible between roofs, but ordinary life here revolves around meals, work, children and keeping the house warm.

People associated with this place include: Atsuko Ōhira — Neighborhood clothing mender.

Snowmelt Landing Flat is available by agreement: 1100 marks for the property purchase. Ask Atsuko Ōhira to inspect it and confirm the actual terms before paying.
Snowmelt Residential Steps.hiddenInfo:
House doors and personal rooms remain private. A blocked drain or roof repair can involve several neighbors with different means, without making the neighborhood destitute. Public gossip may be mistaken; knowing where someone lives is not knowing their private life.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: Room for One More Bench. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

PROPERTY TERMS: Snowmelt Landing Flat has a fixed opening quote of 1100 marks. Its native transaction supplies the key/deed and removes that price once when the owner agrees and the player explicitly commits. Do not also charge or grant it through item generation. A quote, viewing or gift of a key does not silently transfer ownership. Rentals cover the agreed stay, have no background rent drain and need a fresh agreement for an extension; purchases are permanent modest property with no automatic income or free specialist stock. Unavailable sold property is not offered to a second unrelated buyer. Ordinary room access stays local.

Snowmelt Residential Steps - Shared Stai.description: A broad stair passes doorways, stacked firewood and hooks for wet outerwear. Residents keep a narrow cleared line through fresh snow. Visitors can ask directions without treating each household as an open public interior.
paths: Snowmelt Residential Steps - Communal Wash Shelter

Snowmelt Residential Steps - Drain Court.description: Stone channels converge beside a covered drain that must be kept clear of ice and litter. Neighbors notice leaks quickly because water reaches their thresholds. A small maintenance problem can provide useful, ordinary paid work.

Snowmelt Residential Steps - Communal Wa.description: A roofed shelter offers basins and drying lines for local households. Water is supplied through managed distribution rather than by the sacred bones. Work and conversation overlap here, with privacy and access depending on actual custom. Atsuko Ōhira is usually based here, working as neighborhood clothing mender.

Snowmelt Residential Steps - Roofward La.description: A landing above the main stair overlooks a patchwork of chimneys and roofs. Repair ladders are secured when not in use. It is a good meeting place for a resident, not a public route into every upper window.
paths: Snowmelt Residential Steps - Snowmelt Landing Flat

Snowmelt Residential Steps - Snowmelt La.description: A compact landing flat with a sleeping alcove, tiny hearth kitchen, work table and sheltered gear cupboard.

Cinderstone Schoolhouse.name: Cinderstone Schoolhouse
Cinderstone Schoolhouse.basicInfo:
A medium-sized, plain stone schoolhouse provides Drakenspire's ordinary education: reading, arithmetic, local history and practical foundations for daily life. Its modest classrooms also accommodate some adult lessons and community instruction. It is not a fifth magical academy or a rival to Glowhaven's specialist institutions. Serious magic study often takes residents abroad to Glowhaven. Visitors may arrange an educational demonstration, deliver supplies or inquire about public classes through the office rather than interrupting lessons.

People associated with this place include: Aya Tsukino — Cinderstone schoolteacher.
Cinderstone Schoolhouse.hiddenInfo: The building's normal pupils may be children; the world's adult academy-student rule does not turn every local schoolchild into an eighteen-year-old. Adult public instruction and pupil lessons are separate. No named staff or pupil roster is established by this location.

Cinderstone Schoolhouse - School Entranc.description: Boot racks and damp wool line a modest entrance beside the office door. Notices list lessons and community uses of the building. Visitors announce their business rather than walking straight into a class.
paths: Cinderstone Schoolhouse - Reading and Records Room

Cinderstone Schoolhouse - Main Classroom.description: Plain desks face a chalkboard with sums, reading exercises and maps of familiar routes. Daylight enters through high windows. The room supports ordinary teaching, with the actual class and age group determined by the scheduled activity. Aya Tsukino is usually based here, working as cinderstone schoolteacher.

Cinderstone Schoolhouse - Practical Room.description: Measuring tools, simple models and sturdy worktables support hands-on lessons. Supplies are counted and stored after use. A guest can offer a supervised demonstration without transforming the room into an advanced spell laboratory.

Cinderstone Schoolhouse - Reading and Re.description: Shared books stand beside cupboards of attendance and lesson records. Adult learners may use the public reading materials at suitable times. Personal records remain with the school, while local histories can provide a starting point for research.

Lower Hold Gate.name: Lower Hold Gate
Lower Hold Gate.basicInfo:
The main overland gate stands where the lower shelf meets the descending mountain road. Snowbreak walls protect a broad cart entrance, a pedestrian passage and a sheltered inspection yard. Guards and road workers watch weather, loads and reports from the passes. Unlike the magical Portal Room, this gate opens onto the physical mountain routes. Visitors can arrange an escort, learn of a closure or wait for a caravan, while returning residents bring in livestock and supplies.

People associated with this place include: Kensaku Honjō — Lower gate duty officer.
Lower Hold Gate.hiddenInfo: Overland travel is possible but preparation matters. The gate should not become a new realm transition or secretly replace the authorized portal route. A closure follows actual conditions and can have alternatives; guards do not demand a Glowhaven portal key to walk a local road.

Lower Hold Gate - Cart Arch.description: A broad reinforced arch admits wagons and pack animals one group at a time when traffic is heavy. Guards keep the center clear while examining an unusual load. Snow chains and wheel damage are practical concerns here.

Lower Hold Gate - Pedestrian Passage.description: A smaller door opens into a sheltered footway with a view of the road. Travelers check straps and clothing before leaving. Posted warnings describe known conditions, with rumor and confirmed reports kept distinct.

Lower Hold Gate - Holding Yard.description: A walled yard accommodates waiting caravans, deliveries and animals. Water troughs and tie rails are maintained for actual users. A delay can create conversation or a small repair job without trapping the whole city.

Lower Hold Gate - Road Office.description: Route notes, patrol reports and supply schedules fill a cramped office near the gate. Staff can explain current advice and who maintains a road. They cannot promise that weather or territorial creatures will obey yesterday's report. Kensaku Honjō is usually based here, working as lower gate duty officer.

Iwatsugu Clanhold.name: Iwatsugu Clanhold
Iwatsugu Clanhold.basicInfo:
A substantial but practical clan house serves Iwatsugu households and dependents in the capital. The clan's long connections with stonework, quarrying and early settlement give it influence in repairs and public construction, though its members follow many trades. Petitioners discuss contracts, kinship obligations and support for local works in a public receiving wing. The clanhold is a household as well as a political address; visitors are welcomed according to their business, not granted free access to family rooms.

People associated with this place include: Tsubaki Iwatsugu — Acting household administrator of Clan Iwatsugu.
Iwatsugu Clanhold.hiddenInfo:
A chief can value both a sound wall and the workers paid to build it. Contract arguments need not conceal a coup. Membership is not established from a coincidentally shared surname, and a clan association does not prescribe every member's occupation or temperament.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: Three Banners: A Shared Road. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

Iwatsugu Clanhold - Receiving Porch.description: Stone samples and old repair marks decorate a covered porch. Visitors wait near a bell and a table for delivery papers. Practical conversation often begins with which roof, road or wall needs attention.

Iwatsugu Clanhold - Common Hall.description: A broad hearth warms tables used for meals, negotiations and family gatherings. Work notices share wall space with memorial cloths. Business guests enter by invitation and may find an ordinary household meal rather than a political council.

Iwatsugu Clanhold - Works Office.description: Plans, measurements and agreed accounts occupy a small office. Clerks can locate the responsible contractor or explain a promised repair. A persuasive request still needs labor, materials and a decision before work is done. Tsubaki Iwatsugu is usually based here, working as acting household administrator of clan iwatsugu.

Iwatsugu Clanhold - Family Court.description: A quiet inner court separates the receiving wing from private rooms. Snow is swept into a corner beside stored gardening pots. Its domestic use should remain distinct from the clan's public offices.

Yukinose Clanhold.name: Yukinose Clanhold
Yukinose Clanhold.basicInfo:
Yukinose's capital house links rural households, provisioners and people who maintain routes through winter. Its influence rests partly on knowing how food, wool and freight actually reach the city. A busy receiving room handles letters, deliveries and requests from outlying settlements. The house is warm rather than lavish, with space set aside for visiting kin. Clan members are not all shepherds or carriers; shared obligations and history matter more than a single profession.

People associated with this place include: Masatsugu Yukinose — Chief of Clan Yukinose; Koharu Yukinose — Clan Yukinose route captain and provision escort.
Yukinose Clanhold.hiddenInfo: Helping one isolated settlement may mean delaying another load. Such choices can strain relationships without proving malice. The clan does not own every pasture or control all food, and outsiders can work in the same trades without joining it.

Yukinose Clanhold - Delivery Porch.description: Bundles, letters and travelers arriving from smaller settlements pass through a sheltered porch. A board lists expected loads rather than guaranteed stock. Visitors can leave a message or inquire where a delivery belongs. Koharu Yukinose is usually based here, working as clan yukinose route captain and provision escort.

Yukinose Clanhold - Hospitality Hall.description: A large table and dependable hearth welcome invited travelers and family business. Stew and wet-cloak steam mingle in the warm air. Hospitality is personal and finite, not an unlimited supply of free lodging for strangers. Masatsugu Yukinose is usually based here, working as chief of clan yukinose.

Yukinose Clanhold - Provision Office.description: Route accounts and household requests are sorted beside maps of the approaches. Staff compare need with what can actually move in the weather. A useful report from the road may matter more than an impressive title.

Yukinose Clanhold - Guest Landing.description: Simple guest rooms open from a quiet upper landing. Stays are arranged through the household. A traveler resting here remains a guest, not automatically a clan member or political representative.

Arashimine Clanhold.name: Arashimine Clanhold
Arashimine Clanhold.basicInfo:
Arashimine's clan house stands near the routes between the forge district and upper defenses. Its historic ties to arms-making and military service lend weight to discussions of contracts, training and readiness. The building is solid and restrained, with a receiving hall and an enclosed equipment court. Clan pride can coexist with ordinary domestic life, artistic interests and dissent. Visitors may bring a contract, a service petition or a personal invitation; the house is not a public challenge arena.

People associated with this place include: Tomoe Arashimine — Chief of Clan Arashimine; Akitsu Arashimine — Clan Arashimine weapons designer and contract negotiator.
Arashimine Clanhold.hiddenInfo:
A profitable commission may compete with repairs needed by local guards. Members can disagree over price and obligation without sharing one ruthless policy. The clan's martial associations do not confer command of the hold guard on every relative.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: The Blade That Passed: Under the Finish. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

Arashimine Clanhold - Gate Court.description: A stout gate opens onto a cleared court with racks for deliveries. Visitors are directed to the receiving wing before unloading. Weapons stay sheathed during ordinary business unless there is a specific supervised reason to display them.

Arashimine Clanhold - Receiving Hall.description: Old campaign cloths and examples of careful metalwork line a warm hall. Conversations concern families and work as often as battles. Hospitality does not entitle a stranger to demand a duel or inspect private heirlooms.

Arashimine Clanhold - Contract Room.description: Tables hold specifications, delivery records and correspondence with workshops. Disagreement can turn on an exact requirement rather than someone's honor. Original papers remain with their custodians after consultation. Tomoe Arashimine is usually based here, working as chief of clan arashimine.

Arashimine Clanhold - Equipment Court.description: A sheltered rear court allows invited inspection and maintenance of equipment. It is used for practical checks, not public entertainment. Noise is kept within the working hours agreed with neighboring homes. Akitsu Arashimine is usually based here, working as clan arashimine weapons designer and contract negotiator.

The Hold's Judgment House.name: The Hold's Judgment House
The Hold's Judgment House.basicInfo:
A plain civic building handles complaints, evidence and hearings beneath the authority of Drakenspire's government. Residents bring damaged property claims, assault reports and contractual disputes here. Guards maintain a small secure holding space for immediate custody while matters are assessed; it is not Wraith Island Prison or a new realm. The public hall distinguishes testimony from rumor and permits ordinary disputes to be heard without turning every conflict into a clan feud.

People associated with this place include: Setsuna Takigawa — Judge of the Hold's Judgment House.
The Hold's Judgment House.hiddenInfo: Connections can influence who gets heard quickly, but do not erase evidence automatically. Street dueling and assault remain unlawful even when both participants boast of skill. Custody, confiscation and sentencing require actual events; location text alone does not transfer inventory or impose a sentence.

The Hold's Judgment House - Complaints D.description: A counter receives written and spoken reports, with benches for people waiting their turn. Clerks ask what happened, where and who can confirm it. They do not know a stranger's private history without being told.
paths: The Hold's Judgment House - Hearing Room

The Hold's Judgment House - Hearing Room.description: A modest chamber provides places for the presiding official, witnesses and parties to a dispute. Statements can be challenged and documents examined. The room is suitable for a small civil matter as well as a serious accusation. Setsuna Takigawa is usually based here, working as judge of the hold's judgment house.
paths: The Hold's Judgment House - Complaints Desk
The Hold's Judgment House - Evidence Office
The Hold's Judgment House - Holding Passage

The Hold's Judgment House - Evidence Off.description: Locked cupboards and labeled receipts track property submitted for a case. Access is supervised. An object being examined remains under documented custody; narration should not silently remove or return it outside an actual transfer.
paths: The Hold's Judgment House - Hearing Room

The Hold's Judgment House - Holding Pass.description: A guarded passage leads to a few temporary cells and a duty bench. It serves short-term local custody rather than an island prison sentence. A detainee's treatment and release depend on the actual case and authorities involved.
paths: The Hold's Judgment House - Hearing Room

The Tempered Fang.name: The Tempered Fang
The Tempered Fang.basicInfo:
This respected specialist workshop builds and maintains weapons intended to carry learned spellwork. Its smiths discuss balance, grip, channel behavior and the wielder's actual methods before recommending a design. Racks display varied practical forms rather than one compulsory Drakenspire fighting style. A spellblade can commission a blade, arrange a refit or investigate why a trusted weapon behaves poorly. Fine craftsmanship can support a user's abilities; buying an expensive weapon does not teach spells or guarantee victory.

People associated with this place include: Benjirō Kanemori — Master spellblade smith and owner of The Tempered Fang.
The Tempered Fang.hiddenInfo:
The workshop may decline an unsafe specification or recommend an ordinary repair instead of a costly replacement. Material provenance matters when rare scales, crystal or amber are proposed. Any numerical item effects must come from an actual supported item record, not a sales description alone.

CATALOGUE SUPPLY CONTEXT: Appropriate ordinary or specialist stock can include Whitepass Arming Sword; Snowchain Saber; Goatstep Boar Spear; Cairn-Splitter Axe; Hearthforged Greatsword; Ironbound Round Shield. These are exact itemTypes identities, not already granted items or guaranteed unlimited stock. Present a few relevant goods when browsing or a supply request actually happens, with real payment and ownership. Visiting does not buy anything. Rare teaching scrolls may enter a genuine specialist collection or discovery; do not place every scroll in every shop.

The Tempered Fang - Consultation Counter.description: Balanced samples and unfinished grips let customers describe how they fight. The discussion covers reach, handling and casting practice before ornament. A quote may change with the material chosen, but the reason should be explained.

The Tempered Fang - Fitting Floor.description: A clear floor and plain practice targets allow supervised handling checks. Customers test the feel of appropriate samples without striking other visitors. A good fit depends on the person, not simply their height or species. Benjirō Kanemori is usually based here, working as master spellblade smith and owner of the tempered fang.

The Tempered Fang - Channel Bench.description: Fine tools and magnifying lenses surround partly finished spell-channel work. Access is controlled because accidental casting can damage a commission. Inspection can distinguish a damaged conductor from a caster's unfamiliar technique.

The Tempered Fang - Proofing Booth.description: A stone-lined booth permits limited testing with agreed precautions. Marks on the backing record actual tests rather than promises of unlimited power. Completed work is released through the counter after its terms are settled.

Rivet & Rime Armory.name: Rivet & Rime Armory
Rivet & Rime Armory.basicInfo:
A practical armory supplies armor, shields and protective fittings suited to cold travel and hard use. Its stock includes shapes that accommodate horns, tails and different bodies without making every garment an exotic commission. Travelers seek strap replacement, sensible layers and equipment they can actually move in. The armory serves guards, hunters and ordinary workers; expensive decoration is available by commission but does not dominate the shop. A fitting can be a useful conversation about the difference between looking prepared and being prepared.

People associated with this place include: Hibiki Takanashi — Armorer at Rivet & Rime.
Rivet & Rime Armory.hiddenInfo:
The armorer can identify worn fastenings without diagnosing every magical curse. Borrowed or repaired equipment retains its ownership. A disputed fit may be genuine rather than a scam, and altering protective gear requires the customer's actual agreement.

CATALOGUE SUPPLY CONTEXT: Appropriate ordinary or specialist stock can include Rivet-and-Rime Cuirass; Caravan Sallet; Articulated Steel Greaves; Riveted Winter Gauntlets; Iron-Toed Duel Boots. These are exact itemTypes identities, not already granted items or guaranteed unlimited stock. Present a few relevant goods when browsing or a supply request actually happens, with real payment and ownership. Visiting does not buy anything. Rare teaching scrolls may enter a genuine specialist collection or discovery; do not place every scroll in every shop.

Rivet & Rime Armory - Display Room.description: Shields, protective coats and plate fittings hang beside clear examples of repairs. Customers can compare condition and intended use. The room smells of leather dressing and cold metal rather than constant furnace smoke.
paths: Rivet & Rime Armory - Strap and Rivet Bench

Rivet & Rime Armory - Fitting Alcove.description: Screens and a raised fitting platform provide privacy for measurements. Tail openings, joints and layered clothing are checked for movement. Staff treat bodies practically; a dragonkin customer is not a spectacle. Hibiki Takanashi is usually based here, working as armorer at rivet & rime.

Rivet & Rime Armory - Strap and Rivet Be.description: Small hammers and punches sit beside sorted buckles and leather. Minor repairs may be assessed here while the customer waits. Work still needs agreement, materials and completion before the item is restored.

Rivet & Rime Armory - Delivery Cupboard.description: Labeled completed orders are kept behind the counter, separate from general stock. Collection requires the correct customer or authorized messenger. A similar-looking shield on the shelf is not necessarily the one ordered.

The Woolen Wyvern.name: The Woolen Wyvern
The Woolen Wyvern.basicInfo:
A cheerful tailor and winter outfitter sells wool layers, lined coats, gloves and repairs. Its wooden wyvern sign is a shop joke, not evidence that the animal is sacred like a dragon. Customers range from local households replacing worn cuffs to visitors discovering how little their city clothes help in mountain wind. Practical cuts allow horns and tails room without sacrificing warmth. Bright cloth, careful stitching and candid fitting advice make the shop a comfortable stop between harder errands.

People associated with this place include: Shino Kazamaki — Clothier and owner of The Woolen Wyvern.
The Woolen Wyvern.hiddenInfo:
The tailor should recommend appropriate clothing rather than claim every item is enchanted. A rushed festival order or damaged travel coat can create work with modest stakes. A fitting or an admirer of an outfit does not imply romance or consent.

CATALOGUE SUPPLY CONTEXT: Appropriate ordinary or specialist stock can include Woolridge Winter Leggings; Whitepass Snow Boots; Snowchain Freight Cloak; Padded Traveling Cap. These are exact itemTypes identities, not already granted items or guaranteed unlimited stock. Present a few relevant goods when browsing or a supply request actually happens, with real payment and ownership. Visiting does not buy anything. Rare teaching scrolls may enter a genuine specialist collection or discovery; do not place every scroll in every shop.

The Woolen Wyvern - Front Shop.description: Bolts of wool and hanging coats fill a warm, colorful room. A small board lists ordinary repair services. Customers can browse without being pressured into a supposedly essential magical purchase. Shino Kazamaki is usually based here, working as clothier and owner of the woolen wyvern.

The Woolen Wyvern - Fitting Screens.description: Curtained spaces and mirrors allow private fittings. Hooks hold outer layers while sleeve and tail openings are checked. A comfortable garment should account for actual anatomy and movement rather than a generic human silhouette.

The Woolen Wyvern - Mending Table.description: Spools, patches and neatly sorted fasteners surround a broad table. Workers assess frayed seams and torn lining before promising a repair. An old coat may be worth keeping for fit or sentiment even when replacement is possible.

The Woolen Wyvern - Cloth Loft.description: A low loft stores seasonal fabric and unfinished orders away from wet boots. Access is by invitation. Delivery mistakes here involve actual labeled work, not a cache of free luxury outfits.

Coppercrest Exchange.name: Coppercrest Exchange
Coppercrest Exchange.basicInfo:
One of the lower city's conspicuously wealthy buildings, Coppercrest Exchange houses trading rooms, brokers' offices and a covered contract floor. Polished copper trim and tall glass windows contrast with the practical government buildings above. Merchants negotiate metal, magical raw materials and freight capacity here, often linking Drakenspire suppliers with Glowhaven workshops. Visitors can seek an appraisal referral, negotiate a consignment or find transport. The building is a commercial meeting place, not a bank that automatically grants accounts or credit.

People associated with this place include: Iori Yukinose — Clan Yukinose commercial envoy and junior festival patron; Saeha Kogetsu — Proprietor of Coppercrest Exchange.
Coppercrest Exchange.hiddenInfo: Reputation affects negotiations, but a fashionable office does not guarantee solvency. Competing deliveries, disputed samples and risk allocation provide ordinary commercial stakes. No new currency, tax schedule, financial mechanic or magical contract enforcement is created merely by this location.

Coppercrest Exchange - Trading Floor.description: Warm light catches polished rails around tables of samples and paperwork. Brokers introduce actual buyers and sellers rather than announce unlimited demand. A visitor can compare offers while remaining free to walk away. Saeha Kogetsu is usually based here, working as proprietor of coppercrest exchange.

Coppercrest Exchange - Sample Gallery.description: Sealed examples of metal, crystal and amber sit with declared provenance and specifications. Displaying a sample does not prove the entire consignment matches it. Buyers may arrange independent assessment before committing.

Coppercrest Exchange - Negotiation Rooms.description: Small private rooms allow parties to discuss price, delivery and liability. Walls reduce ordinary noise without promising perfect magical secrecy. Agreements remain the terms actually accepted, not whatever a bystander assumes was settled. Iori Yukinose is usually based here, working as clan yukinose commercial envoy and junior festival patron.

Coppercrest Exchange - Freight Ledger Of.description: Carriers and brokers compare available loads, routes and delivery windows. Weather and portal capacity can complicate a plan. A booking does not itself move cargo, issue a court key or grant access to restricted warehouses.

Coppercrest Exchange - Upper Reception.description: A tasteful sitting room offers a view across lower-city roofs toward the sacred crescent. Rich hosts sometimes use it to impress clients. The view and furnishings indicate wealth, not official authority over the Jarl.

Amberglass Assay House.name: Amberglass Assay House
Amberglass Assay House.basicInfo:
A professional assay house evaluates the composition, condition and declared origin of valuable raw materials. Mountain amber, mana crystals, unusual metal and legally obtained creature materials arrive in sealed trays. Its work supports trade and craft rather than serving as a grand magical research academy. Customers can request a defined examination and receive findings with appropriate limits. A certified sample can improve confidence in a deal, but it cannot guarantee every claim about a larger unseen shipment.

People associated with this place include: Takumi Hasebe — Assayer at Amberglass.
Amberglass Assay House.hiddenInfo:
Rare dragon gifts require credible provenance, not a convenient label. An unfertilized egg fragment or shed scale is neither a hatchling nor a guaranteed mana potion. Staff can refuse destructive testing of sacred or disputed property; results need actual work and do not reveal every hidden enchantment automatically.

CATALOGUE SUPPLY CONTEXT: Appropriate ordinary or specialist stock can include Mana Crystal Chips; Clean Amber Sliver; Coldglass Shard; Singing Basalt Core. These are exact itemTypes identities, not already granted items or guaranteed unlimited stock. Present a few relevant goods when browsing or a supply request actually happens, with real payment and ownership. Visiting does not buy anything. Rare teaching scrolls may enter a genuine specialist collection or discovery; do not place every scroll in every shop.

Amberglass Assay House - Intake Counter.description: Samples are received with their owner's account of origin and requested examination. Trays and receipts distinguish one customer's property from another's. The counter establishes custody before testing begins.

Amberglass Assay House - Examination Roo.description: Good light, lenses and calibrated tools support careful inspection of material structure. Appropriate magical methods complement ordinary observation. A test addresses a question; it is not universal identification of every secret an object carries. Takumi Hasebe is usually based here, working as assayer at amberglass.
paths: Amberglass Assay House - Sealed Sample Store

Amberglass Assay House - Sealed Sample S.description: Controlled cupboards separate samples awaiting work from retained reference material. Labels record handling needs and permission for destructive tests. Valuable fragments remain under custody until properly released.

Amberglass Assay House - Findings Desk.description: Completed reports explain what was observed, what remains uncertain and how the sample compares with its claims. Buyers and sellers may discuss a discrepancy here. A report is evidence, not a self-enforcing verdict.

Crystalcutters' Court.name: Crystalcutters' Court
Crystalcutters' Court.basicInfo:
A shared court of small workshops cuts, grades and prepares mana-bearing crystals for further craft. Covered benches face a cleared yard where workers can handle deliveries without crowding delicate work. The trade links mountain extraction with Glowhaven enchantment and local weapon making. Visitors can arrange a cut, seek advice on damaged material or watch permitted demonstrations. The court's expertise is specialized; a beautifully prepared crystal still needs an actual purpose, compatible construction and skilled use.

People associated with this place include: Hotaru Kise — Crystal cutter and bench artisan.
Crystalcutters' Court.hiddenInfo:
A flaw may come from the raw stone, storage or workmanship. Careful evidence can settle responsibility better than an accusation. Offcuts and discarded dust remain workshop material, and neither touching a crystal nor buying it automatically raises a character's Mana.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: A Stone for a Working Hand. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

Crystalcutters' Court - Sorting Yard.description: Covered trays separate rough material by declared origin and visible condition. Workers keep heavy loads away from precision benches. A mislabeled parcel can delay several commissions without threatening the city's entire supply.

Crystalcutters' Court - Cutting Gallery.description: Protected windows allow visitors to observe cutting and polishing at safe distance. Fine grit and bright task lights mark patient work. Entering the working side requires a specific invitation and attention to hazards. Hotaru Kise is usually based here, working as crystal cutter and bench artisan.

Crystalcutters' Court - Design Bench.description: Templates and sample mounts help clients discuss a crystal's intended fit. Shape, flaws and available material constrain the result. A design consultation does not grant the enchantment that another specialist may later apply.

Crystalcutters' Court - Offcut Store.description: Small fragments are kept in labeled containers for reuse or sale. Staff can quote an appropriate batch for a real task. The store is not a limitless source of free magical ammunition.

Resin & Root Apothecary.name: Resin & Root Apothecary
Resin & Root Apothecary.basicInfo:
This compact apothecary sells prepared remedies and supplies practitioners with correctly handled ingredients. Dried mountain plants, resins and preserved creature materials occupy separate cupboards behind a plain counter. Customers come for ordinary care, preparation advice or a specific commission, not only rare magical cures. The proprietor's role is practical service; a reagent's unusual origin does not make it safe to swallow. The shop can connect field collection with responsible assessment and actual potion work.

People associated with this place include: Yoriko Tsumura — Apothecary and healer of Resin & Root.
Resin & Root Apothecary.hiddenInfo:
A useful ingredient still needs identification, preparation and a recipe. The shop's description does not invent new restoration values or guarantee stock of regulated mana medicine. A supplier's substitution can be investigated without making every remedy poisonous or every worker dishonest.

CATALOGUE SUPPLY CONTEXT: Appropriate ordinary or specialist stock can include Field Healing Tonic; Greater Healing Draught; Stable Mana Infusion; Bitter Stamina Tonic; Dried Mooncap Slices. These are exact itemTypes identities, not already granted items or guaranteed unlimited stock. Present a few relevant goods when browsing or a supply request actually happens, with real payment and ownership. Visiting does not buy anything. Rare teaching scrolls may enter a genuine specialist collection or discovery; do not place every scroll in every shop.

Resin & Root Apothecary - Remedy Counter.description: Wrapped preparations and labeled supplies sit behind a clean counter. Questions concern the actual complaint and intended use. A sale or treatment requires an agreed item or service, with effects limited to its real definition.

Resin & Root Apothecary - Ingredient Cab.description: Dry roots, resins and sealed specimens are separated by handling requirements. Visitors can discuss an ingredient without opening every jar. Origin and condition matter, especially when a mountain collector offers something unfamiliar.

Resin & Root Apothecary - Preparation Ro.description: A ventilated workroom contains scales, mortars and clean vessels. Staff prepare actual orders and reject contaminated material. Observation does not instantly teach a complex formula or provide the observer with its finished product.

Resin & Root Apothecary - Consultation N.description: A screened seat allows a quieter conversation about care or a difficult commission. Privacy is ordinary professional discretion, not an impenetrable magical barrier. Serious conditions may require an appropriate healer rather than a convenient bottle. Yoriko Tsumura is usually based here, working as apothecary and healer of resin & root.

Snowchain Freight Yard.name: Snowchain Freight Yard
Snowchain Freight Yard.basicInfo:
A walled freight yard gathers loads for the portalward quarter, local workshops and overland caravans. Roofed bays, chain hoists and broad lanes keep cargo moving without spilling into the market. Workers sort imports, raw materials and completed equipment while carriers plan around weather and access. Visitors can arrange a delivery, find legitimate day work or investigate a delayed consignment. Goods do not become unowned because they are outdoors, and a freight job grants only the tools and access actually agreed.

People associated with this place include: Tsugumi Arata — Snowchain freight dispatcher.
Snowchain Freight Yard.hiddenInfo: Mismatched manifests, damaged packaging and competing deadlines are credible problems. Portal authorization and freight handling remain separate: booking a load here does not issue a court key. Cargo cannot be copied into inventory merely because a worker describes its contents.

Snowchain Freight Yard - Dispatch Shelte.description: A roofed desk coordinates loads, carriers and collection times. Chalkboards show assignments rather than omniscient tracking. A missing delivery requires checking its last confirmed handoff, not guessing the responsible thief. Tsugumi Arata is usually based here, working as snowchain freight dispatcher.

Snowchain Freight Yard - Covered Bays.description: Numbered bays hold sealed freight above the snow. Workers compare labels before moving anything. Buyers, owners and carriers may have different rights to inspect or release the same load.

Snowchain Freight Yard - Hoist Lane.description: Heavy cranes and chain hoists move bulky loads along a clear lane. Bells and shouted warnings keep bystanders out from under suspended cargo. Helping requires suitable skill and supervision rather than a casual strength display.

Snowchain Freight Yard - Carriers' Room.description: A warm room offers benches, route notices and space to repair straps. Carriers exchange practical news while waiting for assignments. Some want conversation; others simply want their meal and a dry pair of gloves.

The Copper Ram.name: The Copper Ram
The Copper Ram.basicInfo:
A busy lower-city tavern serves substantial meals, drink and an easy place to spend an evening. A copper ram above the door is polished by weather and smoke. Workers, merchants and off-duty guards mix without becoming one friendly chorus. Storytelling, complaints and occasional music give the room life; the host expects weapons to stay out of arguments. Visitors can meet people or enjoy their food without being recruited into a quest just for entering.

People associated with this place include: Iroha Sagiri — Host and music arranger at The Copper Ram.
The Copper Ram.hiddenInfo: Alcohol, boasting and jealousy can produce friction, but public assault still has consequences. Tavern gossip is attributed and fallible. A regular's loud claim to have seen a dragon up close does not establish a known lair or rewrite the guardian's distant habits.

The Copper Ram - Taproom.description: Dark beams and warm lamps shelter close-set tables and a long serving counter. Conversation rises and falls with the crowd. A patron's free seat is an opportunity to ask, not automatic permission to join their company. Iroha Sagiri is usually based here, working as host and music arranger at the copper ram.

The Copper Ram - Hearth Tables.description: Larger tables near the fire suit meals and groups of friends. The smell of meat and onions clings to wool sleeves. People here may care more about a delayed wage or a bad joke than national politics.

The Copper Ram - Musicians' Corner.description: A small cleared corner accommodates a singer or a few musicians when someone is performing. At other times it holds ordinary tables. Music adds atmosphere without making every visit a festival.

The Copper Ram - Back Yard.description: A sheltered yard receives deliveries and gives patrons a place for cold air. Staff keep the service route clear. Arguments taken outside do not become lawful duels simply by leaving the taproom.

Hearthpot Stew House.name: Hearthpot Stew House
Hearthpot Stew House.basicInfo:
An inexpensive eating house near the market serves slow-cooked meat, broth, bread and seasonal additions. Its menu follows available supplies, with local cheese and imported ingredients appearing when trade permits. Workers value a warm bowl without ceremony; travelers appreciate being able to eat without bargaining over an adventure. The room is modest, crowded at mealtimes and quieter between them. Takeaway portions and agreed deliveries can connect it to ordinary local work.

People associated with this place include: Daisuke Toyama — Cook and proprietor of Hearthpot Stew House.
Hearthpot Stew House.hiddenInfo: Food nourishes and comforts without automatically applying a magical resource restoration. A short-handed shift or mistaken order can support a small scene. Do not turn the kitchen into an alchemy laboratory or make its regular meals secretly miraculous.

Hearthpot Stew House - Serving Counter.description: Steam clouds the glass near a row of covered pots. Customers choose from the day's actual offerings and settle the price. The counter moves quickly when people know their order and slowly when a large group arrives together. Daisuke Toyama is usually based here, working as cook and proprietor of hearthpot stew house.

Hearthpot Stew House - Shared Tables.description: Plain benches fit workers, families and lone diners into a warm room. Space for tails is negotiated with the same practical courtesy as space for bags. Conversation is possible, but a quiet customer can simply eat.

Hearthpot Stew House - Kitchen Door.description: The kitchen beyond a half-door contains busy cooks and hot equipment. Deliveries and work inquiries are handled without letting visitors crowd the preparation area. Smells and overheard orders convey activity without exposing private business.

Hearthpot Stew House - Pickup Window.description: A small window serves wrapped meals and agreed deliveries to people who cannot linger. Labels and collection times prevent confusion. Receiving someone else's order by mistake does not transfer its ownership.

Stonewake Onsen.name: Stonewake Onsen
Stonewake Onsen.basicInfo:
Drakenspire's one public onsen occupies a sheltered lower ledge where geothermal water is brought up and carefully managed. Stone pools, washing rooms and a warm rest hall provide relief from cold travel and physical work. Bathing arrangements respect privacy, hygiene and actual patron preferences; a shared bath is not an automatic romantic encounter. The springs owe their warmth to the mountain's geology, not the sacred skeleton. Fees, private bookings and treatments are ordinary services rather than universal healing magic.

People associated with this place include: Toki Toyama — Manager of Stonewake Onsen.
Stonewake Onsen.hiddenInfo:
Water temperature and maintenance matter. Staff may close a pool for a real safety issue while keeping other facilities usable. Do not establish extra hot-spring resorts elsewhere in this map or imply bathing cures every wound, curse or exhaustion mechanically.

Local authored opportunities, only when their actual premises and relevant contacts fit: A Table After the Steam. Invitations are optional; do not insert all of them into one arrival, disclose private motives, invent missing people or accept for the player.

Stonewake Onsen - Reception and Shoe Rac.description: A modest reception handles fees, towels and current bathing arrangements. Shoes and travel gear remain outside wet areas. Staff explain available private or shared use without assuming every visitor wants the same experience. Toki Toyama is usually based here, working as manager of stonewake onsen.
paths: Stonewake Onsen - Changing and Washing Rooms
