Feigned Collapse.description: Coordinate a plausible short retreat with informed willing allies to draw enemies toward a real prepared position. Participants spend real movement and effort, and opponents may recognize the bait or decline pursuit. Costs 5 Stamina on commitment.

The Quiet Reserve.name: The Quiet Reserve
The Quiet Reserve.description: Keep one willing ally or prepared resource ready for a specific visible contingency. Waiting has a real opportunity cost and does not create an extra reaction, summon or resource when the contingency arrives. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Crossfire Courtesy.name: Crossfire Courtesy
Crossfire Courtesy.description: Set compatible firing or attack lanes for willing allies through a surveyed immediate space. Their own aim, actions and targets still resolve individually, with no friendly-fire immunity or shared omniscience. Costs 6 Stamina on commitment.

Fold the Front.name: Fold the Front
Fold the Front.description: Direct an organized group manoeuvre against one observed weak point while maintaining a real retreat lane. Communication, space and each participant's actions remain necessary; the plan does not move the entire party for free. Costs 7 Stamina on commitment.

Every Lantern Accounted For.name: Every Lantern Accounted For
Every Lantern Accounted For.description: Coordinate a difficult evacuation through an actual surveyed route, assigning clear jobs and checking who remains. Time, injuries and pursuit are real constraints, and unseen people are not automatically located or rescued. Costs 8 Stamina on commitment.

The Battle Has Another Door.name: The Battle Has Another Door
The Battle Has Another Door.description: Read a complex visible battle and commit the group to one feasible decisive change of objective or position. The plan can create a major opportunity through real actions, without scripting victory, controlling allies or revealing secret enemy plans. Costs 10 Stamina on commitment.

Circuit Tap.name: Circuit Tap
Circuit Tap.description: Inspect an accessible real mana circuit with suitable tools for a loose contact or obvious interruption. The check can locate a simple fault without repairing unknown technology, restoring charges or granting a finished device. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Safe Bleed Valve.name: Safe Bleed Valve
Safe Bleed Valve.description: Use an accessible designed discharge point to vent a small unstable device safely with proper tools. Actual charge is lost rather than transferred into your personal Mana, and an unknown or damaged system can resist safe handling. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Focus Seating.name: Focus Seating
Focus Seating.description: Reseat a compatible loose component in a real casting focus during a careful working interval. Correct tools and a known design are required; broken parts, absent material and spells the user never learned remain separate problems. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Insulated Bypass.name: Insulated Bypass
Insulated Bypass.description: Build a temporary bypass around one identified simple circuit fault using real suitable wire and insulation. The repair needs testing, consumes actual materials and cannot safely bridge every damaged high-power system. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Charged-Line Probe.name: Charged-Line Probe
Charged-Line Probe.description: Use a proper real probe to trace power through an exposed section of a known device. Isolate dangerous loads before touching them; the technique reveals a circuit's response rather than hidden passwords or all its functions. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Bench-Side Stabilizer.name: Bench-Side Stabilizer
Bench-Side Stabilizer.description: Rig a temporary brace or regulator on a known malfunctioning device with actual suitable parts. It can buy time for proper repair, with ongoing load and a failed test still posing a real risk. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Quickrelease Housing.name: Quickrelease Housing
Quickrelease Housing.description: Fit or activate a prepared mechanical quickrelease on your actual equipment under pressure. It can discard a snagged pack or damaged fitting, but the dropped item remains where it falls and cannot be recovered by declaration. Costs 3 Stamina on commitment.

Courier Circuit Pair.name: Courier Circuit Pair
Courier Circuit Pair.description: Calibrate a real compatible pair of short-range signalling devices during a working session. Messages depend on their actual power, range and connection; this creates neither free devices nor unrestricted telepathy. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Reserve Cell Assay.name: Reserve Cell Assay
Reserve Cell Assay.description: Test a real external mana cell's usable charge and safe output with suitable equipment. Record the actual result; knowledge of the reserve grants no personal Mana, invented capacity or automatic full recharge. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Field Housing Patch.name: Field Housing Patch
Field Housing Patch.description: Repair a known device's damaged ordinary housing using actual available tools and material. It restores protection when the work succeeds, while internal faults, enchantments and missing components need their own repair. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Prepared Snare Release.name: Prepared Snare Release
Prepared Snare Release.description: Deploy a real previously built mechanical snare in a reachable prepared position. Its actual design and placement determine the restraint; it consumes or commits that device and does not conjure traps or bypass a target's resistance. Costs 4 Stamina on commitment.

Mana Rail Alignment.name: Mana Rail Alignment
Mana Rail Alignment.description: Align a real powered device's known distribution rails to handle its intended load more reliably. A working interval, suitable instruments and real tests are required; the tune grants no new spell or limitless efficiency. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Shield Emitter Triage.name: Shield Emitter Triage
Shield Emitter Triage.description: Stabilize one real shield emitter whose design you know using suitable parts and an accessible safe work point. The device's actual charge and supported protection remain the limit, without creating a new barrier for free. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Workshop Synchrony.name: Workshop Synchrony
Workshop Synchrony.description: Coordinate several real compatible powered tools for one supervised manufacturing operation. Supply the design, material, energy and safety measures; automated motion does not grant unknown craft knowledge or unattended limitless production. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Heart of the Walking Engine.name: Heart of the Walking Engine
Heart of the Walking Engine.description: Diagnose and rebuild one known complex mana-powered mechanism during a substantial workshop project. Real components, power tests and actual engineering knowledge determine success, and a functioning construct gains no invented conscious soul. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

The Machine Learns Its Name.name: The Machine Learns Its Name
The Machine Learns Its Name.description: Design and commission a major integrated magitech device through a real engineering project with tested subsystems and actual materials. Spellcraft is also required if its magical blueprint is new or substantially redesigned; this technique grants neither an instant artifact nor a new spell by itself. Costs no personal Mana or Stamina; actual time, tools and stated conditions still apply.

Prismknuckle Entry.name: Prismknuckle Entry
Prismknuckle Entry.description: Wrap a trained fist or heavy weapon in a compact arcane shell and commit one close strike. The shell supports the physical delivery rather than making a second projectile or adding a second full skill total. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Glass Edge Intercept.name: Glass Edge Intercept
Glass Edge Intercept.description: Shape a short arcane extension along your real guard to catch one approaching line just outside normal reach. It is one timed defence using trained physical delivery; a successful catch grants no free counterattack. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Emberheel Crescent.name: Emberheel Crescent
Emberheel Crescent.description: Sweep a close kick or light weapon through a controlled burning crescent. Resolve the timed strike once, with one-metre extra flame reach and real fuel determining any continuing fire. Costs 10 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Tidemark Draw.name: Tidemark Draw
Tidemark Draw.description: Guide a thin ribbon of water along one precise close strike to hook a guard off line. Contact and footing contest the opening, and the same action supplies no separate unrestricted water attack. Costs 10 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Quarrystone Knuckle.name: Quarrystone Knuckle
Quarrystone Knuckle.description: Sheathe one trained striking surface in temporary stone and commit a heavy close blow. Its weight supports the impact but can slow recovery; the stone fades and the move grants no independent earth projectile. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Faultline Sentinel.name: Faultline Sentinel
Faultline Sentinel.description: Brace a real close guard with a small raised earth support while meeting one incoming force. Suitable ground, timing and the attack determine protection, with no automatic wall around the whole party. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Galeheel Change.name: Galeheel Change
Galeheel Change.description: Kick a brief gust from your soles to sharpen a short real sidestep or passing strike. Choose movement or the attack as the manoeuvre’s purpose; the gust grants neither flight nor a second action. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Breakers Under the Palm.name: Breakers Under the Palm
Breakers Under the Palm.description: Drive a trained close palm or heavy weapon into a compact forward gust. Resolve one forceful line up to 3 metres long, with bracing and actual pressure rather than a free physical hit plus a separate spell. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Stormheel Crash.name: Stormheel Crash
Stormheel Crash.description: Land a heavy kick or close weapon blow with a short electrical discharge at its actual contact point. The whole strike resolves once, and insulation, grounding and a missed delivery remain meaningful. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Hoarfrost Parapet.name: Hoarfrost Parapet
Hoarfrost Parapet.description: Grow a brief ice lip from your real shield or grounded guard to meet one incoming line. Correct angle and the temporary ice’s integrity decide protection; this is no full room wall or automatic freezing counter. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Sunblade Salute.name: Sunblade Salute
Sunblade Salute.description: Draw a bright short-lived edge along a trained light weapon and make one precise strike. The glare can complicate reading that line, but sight protection, cover and physical defence still matter. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Noonday Aegis Turn.name: Noonday Aegis Turn
Noonday Aegis Turn.description: Angle a controlled flash from your real guard while turning one visible approach aside. It supports that defence by spoiling visual aim, with no Healing, physical invulnerability or independent retaliatory beam. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Ironclad Shoulder.name: Ironclad Shoulder
Ironclad Shoulder.description: Form temporary reinforcing plates over a trained shoulder, fist or heavy weapon for one committed collision. The added structure supports a physical shove or strike and disappears afterward instead of becoming free armour. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Silverhook Riposte.name: Silverhook Riposte
Silverhook Riposte.description: Shape a brief metal hook along a real trained weapon and use it for one timed disarm or returning strike. Choose the purpose before resolving contact; this does not automatically control every metal object nearby. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Bramble Clinch.name: Bramble Clinch
Bramble Clinch.description: Support an established physical clinch with a few temporary hooked vines at its contact points. The combined restraint is one contested manoeuvre, with cutting, strength and positioning offering actual escapes. Costs 10 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Bellknuckle Cross.name: Bellknuckle Cross
Bellknuckle Cross.description: Release a compact resonant burst at the contact point of one trained punch or heavy close strike. The sound intensifies that impact without a second attack roll, automatic deafness or a shockwave through the whole room. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Quiet Bell Parry.name: Quiet Bell Parry
Quiet Bell Parry.description: Tune a brief vibration through your real guard as you meet one incoming weapon or material strike. It can jar the contacting surface, but must win the physical timing and material contest rather than shattering any weapon. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Falling Sky Anchor.name: Falling Sky Anchor
Falling Sky Anchor.description: Increase your downward support while receiving one major close impact through a trained guard. Your real footing and the attack’s scale decide what holds; the stance can hinder your own immediate movement. Costs 14 Mana and 6 Stamina on commitment.

Folded Point.name: Folded Point
Folded Point.description: Shorten the last half-metre of one visible close weapon line through a controlled spatial fold. Resolve one trained physical attack with that limited reach; it cannot place an edge inside unseen anatomy or bypass a sealed route. Costs 14 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Nearside Bastion.name: Nearside Bastion
Nearside Bastion.description: Shift yourself and the real guard you hold up to one metre onto a directly seen safe footing while meeting one visible threat. This is one defensive relocation with a real landing, not an extra free teleport after another action. Costs 16 Mana and 6 Stamina on commitment.

Duskfang Passing Cut.name: Duskfang Passing Cut
Duskfang Passing Cut.description: Deepen the shadow along a real passing strike to make its visible edge harder to follow. The attack remains physical and reachable, without shadow teleportation, personal Mana draining or automatic counterspell. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Hollow Guard Catch.name: Hollow Guard Catch
Hollow Guard Catch.description: Layer a small dampening patch over your real guard where one observed magical line is about to meet it. Both the physical defence and opposed magic matter; it does not suppress the attacker’s whole discipline. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Steady Hands Escort.name: Steady Hands Escort
Steady Hands Escort.description: Use a trained supporting hold to move one willing injured creature a few safe steps while easing localized pain. This is an evacuation manoeuvre, with no Health restoration, repaired injury or immunity to attacks. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Mercy’s Narrow Window.name: Mercy’s Narrow Window
Mercy’s Narrow Window.description: Use precise trained movement to reach one willing adjacent patient through a real contested opening and apply brief direct treatment. On successful treatment restore up to 8% of their maximum Health once, rounded down; the whole action is care and positioning rather than an added attack. Round restoration down, cap it at actual maximum Health, and apply an already resolved recovery only once. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Runes on the Knuckles.name: Runes on the Knuckles
Runes on the Knuckles.description: Inscribe a momentary reinforcing pattern over a trained striking surface before one committed close blow. The enchantment supports that physical delivery without granting lasting strength, a second hit or unknown weapon proficiency. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Faithful Guard Script.name: Faithful Guard Script
Faithful Guard Script.description: Tune a temporary reinforcement into the actual shield or weapon with which you meet one incoming line. It aids one resolved defence and then fades, granting neither a permanent item bonus nor autonomous protection. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Courser’s Joined Turn.name: Courser’s Joined Turn
Courser’s Joined Turn.description: Coordinate one real quick manoeuvre with an already present controlled mount or familiar suited to it. Its movement and your own delivery share the actual command budget; this neither summons it for free nor adds an independent attack. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Guest Behind the Shield.name: Guest Behind the Shield
Guest Behind the Shield.description: Align your real guard with an already present controlled guardian to cover one immediate line together. Both participants need actual position and capability, and their shared defence consumes your command rather than granting two full turns. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

False Hem Draw.name: False Hem Draw
False Hem Draw.description: Overlay a brief false sleeve or weapon line on your real draw to bait a mistaken defence. The opponent can read the deception, and only the actual physical strike can injure them. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Double at the Door.name: Double at the Door
Double at the Door.description: Place a brief visual double beside your real guarded stance to confuse one observed approach. Choose and resolve one real defence; the image has no substance and cannot block a second independent attack. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Omen at the Wrist.name: Omen at the Wrist
Omen at the Wrist.description: Read an observed opponent’s immediate rhythm while committing one precise strike at a genuine opening. Their choices, feints and unknown techniques preserve uncertainty; the reading grants no guaranteed future or unavoidable hit. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

The Shield Before the Sound.name: The Shield Before the Sound
The Shield Before the Sound.description: Anticipate one visible attack’s likely line and set your real guard to receive it. This informed defence remains contested and can fail if the opponent changes the pattern or another threat intervenes. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

Pale Edge Greeting.name: Pale Edge Greeting
Pale Edge Greeting.description: Attune a real trained weapon or hand to contact one perceived incorporeal hostile entity during a close strike. Resolve the spiritual contact once; it calls no deceased soul and grants no life or Mana extraction. Costs 8 Mana and 4 Stamina on commitment.

Graveward Stance.name: Graveward Stance
Graveward Stance.description: Hold a trained defensive position while anchoring a small spiritual ward over yourself and one willing adjacent ally. It contests one identified spiritual intrusion for the exchange, without animating remains or binding a conscious soul. Costs 12 Mana and 5 Stamina on commitment.

The Seventh Counterstroke.name: The Seventh Counterstroke
The Seventh Counterstroke.description: Shape a tight plane of raw mana at an incoming physical projectile and strike it off its line. Resolve one Arcane Magic defense against the actual attack; a successful deflection does not automatically return it to its owner or erase an area blast. Costs 24 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Arcane Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Foxfire Procession.name: Foxfire Procession
Foxfire Procession.description: Guide a small procession of floating flames along a visible route for light, a distraction or a controlled ignition. Direct each flame deliberately; they are not intelligent familiars, and scattered flames do not become several free attacks. Costs 10 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Fire Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The River Wears Your Face.name: The River Wears Your Face
The River Wears Your Face.description: Draw nearby water into a roughly person-shaped moving decoy under direct control. Its wavering surface can confuse a brief observation, obstruct a path or absorb an impact; it has no mind, spells or independent turns. Costs 22 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Water Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

requirements.variable: Formula: The River Wears Your Face

The Mason's Last Word.name: The Mason's Last Word
The Mason's Last Word.description: Raise a short, heavy barrier from suitable real earth or stone at a visible point. Its size and thickness must fit the available material and the actual result; it does not grow inside a body or seal every possible escape. Costs 28 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Earth Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The Hundredth Feather.name: The Hundredth Feather
The Hundredth Feather.description: Spread a cushioning updraft beneath up to three nearby falling people for a brief descent. It slows an actual fall according to control, weight and available space; it provides neither sustained flight nor an extra action. Costs 14 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Wind Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Thunder's Second Name.name: Thunder's Second Name
Thunder's Second Name.description: Send a deliberately forked discharge toward at most two close, clearly perceived targets. Resolve the actual Lightning Magic attack and each target's protection; the fork is one working rather than an automatic second hit or guaranteed paralysis. Costs 30 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Lightning Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Winter's Borrowed Crown.name: Winter's Borrowed Crown
Winter's Borrowed Crown.description: Form a curved crown of temporary ice plates around a nearby threatened position. Use one Ice Magic defense; the brittle plates can absorb or redirect a suitable impact before shattering, without surrounding the caster in absolute protection. Costs 24 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Ice Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Noon Behind Closed Eyes.name: Noon Behind Closed Eyes
Noon Behind Closed Eyes.description: Release a tightly directed brilliant flash toward a visible approach. It can spoil aim or briefly overwhelm exposed vision when the contest succeeds. Closed eyes, cover and actual protection matter; the flash is not healing or a guaranteed stun. Costs 12 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Light Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The Blacksmith's White Lie.name: The Blacksmith's White Lie
The Blacksmith's White Lie.description: Temporarily soften and reshape one small, accessible piece of real metal under controlled touch. It can bend a fitting or ease a jam with an appropriate result; complex locks, reinforced alloys and hostile resistance still need real work. Costs 20 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Metal Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

A Garden Between Heartbeats.name: A Garden Between Heartbeats
A Garden Between Heartbeats.description: Raise a brief thicket of temporary stems and thorns across a small suitable patch of ground. Use its real reach to obstruct, contain or threaten; targets can resist or force another route. It creates neither lasting food nor healing for animals or people. Costs 26 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Nature Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The Bell That Answers Nothing.name: The Bell That Answers Nothing
The Bell That Answers Nothing.description: Dampen a small area around a visible point for a short interval, making ordinary sound difficult to carry. The effect can conceal a noise or hinder audible coordination, but does not automatically cancel silent casting or every form of magic. Costs 22 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Sound Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

requirements.variable: Formula: The Bell That Answers Nothing

Crownfall Waltz.name: Crownfall Waltz
Crownfall Waltz.description: Tilt the local pull across a small visible patch to disrupt footing or draw loose objects toward an edge. Resolve one Gravity Magic working with actual weight and resistance. It creates no black hole, inevitable fall or free sequence of attacks. Costs 30 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Gravity Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The Seam That Holds.name: The Seam That Holds
The Seam That Holds.description: Temporarily reinforce the actual seams and fastenings of one worn garment or light piece of equipment. It supports an appropriate defense or prevents a stressed join from giving way. It is not a permanent item upgrade or an added inventory bonus. Costs 12 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Enchantment Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Mercy's Last Stitch.name: Mercy's Last Stitch
Mercy's Last Stitch.description: Attempt a concentrated repair of appropriate fresh bodily injury in one reachable living target, restoring about 35 percent of its actual maximum Health on a full suitable success, capped by the real injury. Failed or partial work follows the result. It does not reverse aging, resurrect or cure an unrelated lasting condition. Costs 30 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Healing Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

A Guest Made of Rain.name: A Guest Made of Rain
A Guest Made of Rain.description: Call one small temporary water elemental with a simple agreed task. Its actual body, presence and actions must be established as a summon; it has no automatic attack on arrival, independent spell repertoire or permanent place in the party. Sustaining and directing it uses real attention. Costs 28 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Summoning Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

requirements.variable: Formula: A Guest Made of Rain

The Applause Behind You.name: The Applause Behind You
The Applause Behind You.description: Project a brief, localized illusion of applause and movement at a visible nearby point. It can draw attention or support a feint when believed, without compelling a target's action or creating real spectators. Costs 12 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Illusion Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Footprint of the Unchosen Road.name: Footprint of the Unchosen Road
Footprint of the Unchosen Road.description: Seek a brief, uncertain impression of one immediate hazard or consequence along a route actually under consideration. Interpret the actual vision and evidence; it is not a map of every danger, verified testimony or control over time. Costs 24 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Divination Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

requirements.variable: Formula: Footprint of the Unchosen Road

The Hole in the Chorus.name: The Hole in the Chorus
The Hole in the Chorus.description: Direct a narrow disruptive absence into one exposed, ongoing magical effect. Contest the real working; scope and resistance govern interruption. It cannot erase every spell, a permanent artifact or the public portal network by declaration. Costs 28 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Void Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

requirements.variable: Formula: The Hole in the Chorus

The Door Within Reach.name: The Door Within Reach
The Door Within Reach.description: Attempt a displacement of no more than three meters to a clearly perceived safe point within the same immediate place. It needs the established Gravity foundation and actual Space control. Resolve the movement and destination honestly; it neither crosses realm boundaries nor supplies public portal permission. Costs 26 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Space Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The Ferryman's Small Courtesy.name: The Ferryman's Small Courtesy
The Ferryman's Small Courtesy.description: Offer a respectful channel through which one actually present minor spirit can answer a short question or signal a preference. Its knowledge, agency and willingness remain its own. A response is not compelled truth, resurrection or contact with every dead person. Costs 16 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Soul Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Paper Moon Phalanx.name: Paper Moon Phalanx
Paper Moon Phalanx.description: Arrange three connected planes of temporary raw-mana geometry into a moving defensive screen. They form one controlled working with real limits and openings, not three autonomous combatants. It requires sustained attention and an actual Arcane Magic defense. Costs 42 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Arcane Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Cathedral of Cinders.name: Cathedral of Cinders
Cathedral of Cinders.description: Raise a ring of intense fire around a visible position, no more than five meters across. Control its real heat and direction through an extreme Fire Magic working; maintaining it takes attention. It does not strike everyone automatically, spare allies by assumption or create free extra turns. Costs 55 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Fire Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Hollow-Lake Reversal.name: Hollow-Lake Reversal
Hollow-Lake Reversal.description: Gather a substantial nearby body of existing water into one controlled surge and turn it along a chosen visible course. Mass, footing, structures and resistance constrain the result. The water moves now; no event, injury or moment is rewound. Costs 48 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Water Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Sleeping Dune Coffin.name: Sleeping Dune Coffin
Sleeping Dune Coffin.description: Drive existing loose earth or sand upward around one target's lower body to restrain movement. Resistance, footing and escape attempts matter; entombment is dangerous and is not an automatic captured or dead result. Costs 30 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Earth Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The Uninvited Gale.name: The Uninvited Gale
The Uninvited Gale.description: Drive a sharp, shaped gust across a short visible approach, scattering unsecured objects and contesting the footing of those in its path. Its actual size and force follow the working, without automatically throwing every target or extending through solid walls. Costs 26 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Wind Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Lighthouse in Your Hand.name: Lighthouse in Your Hand
Lighthouse in Your Hand.description: Concentrate a bright steady beam from a held point for illumination, signaling or a deliberately focused attack. Resolve its actual line, exposure and protection. Illumination supplies no hidden knowledge, healing or automatic hit. Costs 25 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Light Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Borrowed Breath.name: Borrowed Breath
Borrowed Breath.description: Attempt urgent stabilization of a reachable living patient who can still be saved, supporting breathing and the immediate failing condition. An appropriate success restores up to 20 Health once and addresses that actual emergency. It is not resurrection, invulnerability or a cure for every poison. Costs 28 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Healing Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

One More Chore.name: One More Chore
One More Chore.description: Animate one small set of actual animal remains for a brief simple physical task. This working moves remains without calling their former conscious soul. The resulting servant needs actual placement and limited actions, and its animation ends when the task or sustaining control ends. Costs 24 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Soul Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

The Coppersmith's Pet Dragon.name: The Coppersmith's Pet Dragon
The Coppersmith's Pet Dragon.description: Shape and directly guide a small length of real wire as a jointed dragonlike tool for reaching, gripping or a precise feint. Its metal, reach and force remain finite. It has no mind, breath weapon, free independent attack or permanent familiar bond. Costs 24 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Metal Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

Invitation to an Empty Room.name: Invitation to an Empty Room
Invitation to an Empty Room.description: Lay a convincing visual and audible impression over one visible doorway or opening, suggesting an empty interior from a limited approach. Observation, touch, movement and contrary evidence can expose it. The illusion does not alter the actual room or transport anyone. Costs 24 Mana when the working is committed, including a failed committed cast. Casting uses Illusion Magic; knowing the formula does not guarantee its result.

requirements.variable: Formula: Invitation to an Empty Room

Margin Remembered.name: Margin Remembered
Margin Remembered.description: Carefully reconstruct a previously observed page, route detail or conversation relevant to the present investigation. Resolve an investigation check with this bonus; missing observations and a misleading original remain missing or misleading. Costs 4 Stamina for a committed concentrated attempt.

Before the Glass Falls.name: Before the Glass Falls
Before the Glass Falls.description: Use a sound, motion or other plausible nearby cue to notice an immediate developing hazard. Resolve Perception with this bonus. It reveals only what that cue can support and does not automatically evade an attack or identify an unseen culprit. Costs 5 Stamina.

Late Bell Sidestep.name: Late Bell Sidestep
Late Bell Sidestep.description: Commit to a quick evasive step against an actual incoming threat, using acrobatics or the existing Finesse delivery appropriate to the action. Apply this bonus to one defend resolution, not both. A supplied miss or hit remains authoritative. Costs 6 Stamina.

The Door Holds.name: The Door Holds
The Door Holds.description: Set a real guard against one approaching attack or attempt to force passage. Resolve Guarded Combat with this bonus. It protects the space you can actually cover and gives no immunity, extra attack or automatic restraint. Costs 8 Stamina.

Needle Between Beats.name: Needle Between Beats
Needle Between Beats.description: Make one precise Finesse Combat attack against an actual reachable target, using this bonus. Describe a concrete opening rather than granting another action or ignoring armor. Costs 8 Stamina.

Gatepost Reprimand.name: Gatepost Reprimand
Gatepost Reprimand.description: Commit to one powerful Force Combat strike with an actual suitable weapon or trained bodily method. This bonus improves that one resolution; there is no additional knockback or structural destruction without the actual outcome. Costs 12 Stamina.

Borrow the Balance.name: Borrow the Balance
Borrow the Balance.description: Attempt one close grapple, escape or controlled takedown through Force Combat or athletics as the actual action requires. Use the bonus once. Size, reach, footing and resistance still apply; no automatic restraint follows. Costs 8 Stamina.

One Quiet Line.name: One Quiet Line
One Quiet Line.description: Take a deliberate shot with an actual held bow, crossbow, sling or throwing weapon. Resolve the appropriate Finesse Combat attack with this bonus and spend real ammunition where applicable. No second shot or impossible line of sight. Costs 7 Stamina.

First Clean Draft.name: First Clean Draft
First Clean Draft.description: Make one actual Spellcraft design or revision attempt for a feasible working within your knowledge. Apply this bonus to the invention check. Difficult work still needs its real research and materials; a successful draft does not grant automatic mastery or a second free ability. Costs 8 Mana for a committed magical test.

Lanternjaw Spark.name: Lanternjaw Spark
Lanternjaw Spark.description: Release a compact jaw-shaped snap of fire at one nearby reachable target. Resolve Fire Magic with this bonus. It is one ordinary attack with bounded flame, not a lasting creature or automatic ignition of the surroundings. Costs 9 Mana.

Blue Needle Current.name: Blue Needle Current
Blue Needle Current.description: Direct a narrow current through available water or temporary conjured water at one reachable target. Resolve Water Magic with this bonus. A contested disarm or interruption is an alternative purpose, not extra free damage. Costs 9 Mana.

Stone Palm Courtesy.name: Stone Palm Courtesy
Stone Palm Courtesy.description: Raise or shift a small reachable section of ordinary earth into a low brace or obstacle. Resolve Earth Magic with this bonus when contested. It needs real footing or temporary conjuration and cannot collapse a building by declaration. Costs 10 Mana.

Ribbon Through the Air.name: Ribbon Through the Air
Ribbon Through the Air.description: Guide a precise gust to move one light unattended object, clear a small patch of smoke or attempt a bounded interruption. Resolve Wind Magic with this bonus if uncertain. No unrestricted flight or automatic disarm. Costs 8 Mana.

Bluebell Discharge.name: Bluebell Discharge
Bluebell Discharge.description: Send one short controlled electrical discharge at a nearby reachable target. Resolve Lightning Magic with this bonus. It gives no automatic stun, extra chain attack or safe passage through unrelated conductors. Costs 10 Mana.

Winter's Fine Signature.name: Winter's Fine Signature
Winter's Fine Signature.description: Form a thin bounded frost pattern on one nearby surface or attempt one small ice attack. Resolve Ice Magic with this bonus. Freezing an entire person, room or body of water is outside its scope. Costs 10 Mana.

Single Star Aperture.name: Single Star Aperture
Single Star Aperture.description: Shape one clear light or direct a narrow light ray at an actual target. Resolve Light Magic with this bonus when opposed. It grants no healing, automatic blindness or hidden-information revelation. Costs 9 Mana.

Briar Buttonhole.name: Briar Buttonhole
Briar Buttonhole.description: Shape a small nearby plant into a useful tendril or attempt one limited thorn attack or binding. Resolve Nature Magic with this bonus. Resistance remains real; temporary conjured plant matter fades with the working. Costs 10 Mana.

Borrowed Surface.name: Borrowed Surface
Borrowed Surface.description: Alter the apparent color or simple surface detail of one small visible object for the immediate scene. Resolve Illusion Magic with this bonus against scrutiny. It changes no physical property, inventory record, credential or ownership. Costs 8 Mana.

Black Margin.name: Black Margin
Black Margin.description: Attempt to interrupt one nearby modest active working with a brief Void cut. Resolve Void Magic with this bonus against its actual strength. A failed interruption stands; it is no universal antimagic field or cancellation of resolved damage. Costs 12 Mana.

The Stitch Holds.name: The Stitch Holds
The Stitch Holds.description: Perform one feasible nonmagical stabilization or treatment using actual Medicine, supplies and access to the patient. Apply this bonus to Medicine. Recovery follows the actual treatment; there is no resurrection, instant organ restoration or second healing award. Costs 6 Stamina.

Crimson Thread, Gentle Knot.name: Crimson Thread, Gentle Knot
Crimson Thread, Gentle Knot.description: Attempt basic Healing Magic on one reachable living patient, using this bonus. A successful result restores the normal basic amount once under Health instructions. Actual condition and limits apply; the working cannot reverse death or aging. Costs 12 Mana.

Little Door, Little Guest.name: Little Door, Little Guest
Little Door, Little Guest.description: Summon one temporary palm-sized noncombat helper for a simple nearby task such as carrying a light object or retrieving an accessible dropped tool. Resolve Summoning Magic with this bonus when uncertain. No attack, scouting through sealed walls, permanent materials or duplicate helpers. Costs 12 Mana; the helper departs when this immediate task ends.

Lantern for an Echo.name: Lantern for an Echo
Lantern for an Echo.description: Examine one actual nearby spiritual residue or attempt a modest spiritual ward using Soul Magic with this bonus. Preserve uncertainty about identity and cause. No involuntary soul extraction, automatic possession cure or raising the dead. Costs 12 Mana.

A Better Use for This.name: A Better Use for This
A Better Use for This.description: Attempt one plausible improvised repair or adaptation with actual equipment, available materials and the relevant Magitech method. Apply this bonus once. It creates no absent tool, permanent new enchantment, free item or automatic quality upgrade. Costs 8 Stamina.

Chalkstar Needle.name: Chalkstar Needle
Chalkstar Needle.description: Send a narrow raw-mana dart through one exposed gap; precise aim matters more than impact. Costs 4 Mana on a committed attempt, including failure. Use the actual Arcane Magic resolution; no guaranteed success or unlisted free action follows.

Lantern Cage.name: Lantern Cage
Lantern Cage.description: Arrange three small force panes around an object to catch a falling load; the open sides remain open. Costs 5 Mana on a committed attempt, including failure. Use the actual Arcane Magic resolution; no guaranteed success or unlisted free action follows.

Cathedral of Lines.name: Cathedral of Lines
Cathedral of Lines.description: Build a waist-high interlocking force lattice that divides one approach and gives allies cover; it has real breakable surfaces. Costs 9 Mana on a committed attempt, including failure. Sustaining the effect beyond its immediate working requires continued concentration and proportionate Mana; temporary conjured matter fades. Use the actual Arcane Magic resolution; no guaranteed success or unlisted free action follows.

Borrowed Orbit.name: Borrowed Orbit
Borrowed Orbit.description: Keep one small carried tool circling within arm's reach, then send it along a chosen short path; this grants no extra attack. Costs 12 Mana on a committed attempt, including failure. Use the actual Arcane Magic resolution; no guaranteed success or unlisted free action follows.

Crown of Interception.name: Crown of Interception
Crown of Interception.description: Prepare several bounded force facets to intercept one approaching volley; gaps, strength and the actual result still matter. Costs 20 Mana on a committed attempt, including failure. Sustaining the effect beyond its immediate working requires continued concentration and proportionate Mana; temporary conjured matter fades. Use the actual Arcane Magic resolution; no guaranteed success or unlisted free action follows.

The Last Clear Equation.name: The Last Clear Equation
The Last Clear Equation.description: Unmake one understood hostile construct by attacking a structural junction; powerful unfamiliar magic requires investigation and can resist. Costs 32 Mana on a committed attempt, including failure. Sustaining the effect beyond its immediate working requires continued concentration and proportionate Mana; temporary conjured matter fades. Use the actual Arcane Magic resolution; no guaranteed success or unlisted free action follows.

Cinder March.name: Cinder March
Cinder March.description: Move behind a brief low ember screen without treating it as solid cover or invisibility. Costs 4 Mana on a committed attempt, including failure. Use the actual Fire Magic resolution; no guaranteed success or unlisted free action follows.

Kettlewick Touch.name: Kettlewick Touch
Kettlewick Touch.description: Warm a small existing object to a controlled useful temperature; living tissue and dangerous materials demand caution. Costs 5 Mana on a committed attempt, including failure. Use the actual Fire Magic resolution; no guaranteed success or unlisted free action follows.

Emberglass Fan.name: Emberglass Fan
Emberglass Fan.description: Send a broad short fan of sparks that threatens an exposed approach without a room-filling explosion. Costs 9 Mana on a committed attempt, including failure. Sustaining the effect beyond its immediate working requires continued concentration and proportionate Mana; temporary conjured matter fades.
